title.zh: 卷四十一 本紀第四十一 理宗一
title.raw: 卷四十一 本紀第四十一 理宗一 Volume 41 Annals 41: Lizong 1

sentences.zh: 理宗建道備德大功復興烈文仁武聖明安孝皇帝，諱昀，太祖十世孫。

translations.literal: Emperor Lizong Jian Dao Bei De Da Gong Fu Xing Lie Wen Ren Wu Sheng Ming An Xiao, taboo name Yun, tenth-generation descendant of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Lizong—posthumously honored as Jian Dao Bei De Da Gong Fu Xing Lie Wen Ren Wu Sheng Ming An Xiao—whose personal name was Yun, was a tenth-generation descendant of Emperor Taizu.

sentences.zh: 父希瓐，追封榮王，家於紹興府山陰縣，母全氏。

translations.literal: His father was Xi Yong, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Rong; the family lived in Shanyin County, Shaoxing Prefecture; his mother was the Lady Quan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xi Yong was later posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Rong; the household was in Shanyin County, Shaoxing Prefecture; his mother was of the Quan clan.

sentences.zh: 以開禧元年正月癸亥生於邑中虹橋裏第。

translations.literal: On guihai of the first month of the first year of Kaiyi, he was born at the residence in Rainbow Bridge Lane within the district.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on guihai of the first month in the first year of Kaiyi (1205), at the family house in Rainbow Bridge Lane.

sentences.zh: 前一夕，榮王夢一紫衣金帽人來謁，比寤，夜漏未盡十刻，室中五采爛然，赤光屬天，如日正中。

translations.literal: On the previous evening the Prince of Rong dreamed a man in purple robes and a golden cap came to pay respects; when he awoke, before the night watch had passed ten quarters, the chamber blazed with the five colors, and crimson light reached the sky like the sun at its zenith.
translations.idiomatic: The night before, the Prince of Rong dreamed that a visitor in purple robes and a golden cap came to call; when he woke, before ten night-watches had elapsed, the room shone with all five colors, and scarlet light rose to the sky as though the sun stood at noon.

sentences.zh: 既誕三日，家人聞戶外車馬聲，亟出，無所睹。

translations.literal: Three days after his birth the household heard chariot and horse sounds outside; they rushed out but saw nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Three days after the birth, the family heard the sound of chariots and horses outside the door; they hurried out at once, yet saw no one.

sentences.zh: 幼嘗晝寢，人忽見身隱隱如龍鱗。

translations.literal: In childhood he once slept by day; someone suddenly saw his body faintly like dragon scales.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he once napped by day, and someone suddenly noticed his body seeming faintly covered with dragon scales.

sentences.zh: 是時，寧宗弟沂靖惠王薨，無嗣，以宗室希瞿子賜名均爲沂王后，尋改賜名貴和。

translations.literal: At that time the younger brother of Ningzong, the Prince of Yijing and Huai, died without heirs; the clansman Xi Qu's son, granted the name Jun, was made heir to the Prince of Yi, and soon granted the name Guihe.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Ningzong's younger brother, the Prince of Yijing and Huai, died without issue; Xi Qu's son in the imperial clan, given the name Jun, was adopted as heir to the Prince of Yi, and soon renamed Guihe.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十三年八月，景獻太子薨，寧宗以國本未立，選太祖十世孫年十五以上者教育，如高宗擇普安、恩平故事，遂以十四年六月丙寅立貴和爲皇子，改賜名竑，而以帝嗣沂王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the thirteenth year of Jiading the Jingxian Crown Prince died; Ningzong, because the succession was unsettled, selected tenth-generation descendants of Taizu aged fifteen or above for instruction, following Gaozong's precedent in choosing between Pu'an and Enping; on bingyin of the sixth month of the fourteenth year Guihe was installed as crown prince, renamed Gou, while the Emperor succeeded as heir to the Prince of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the thirteenth year of Jiading (1220), the Jingxian Crown Prince died. With the imperial succession still unsettled, Ningzong chose tenth-generation descendants of Taizu who were fifteen or older for training, following the precedent of Gaozong's selection between the Pu'an and Enping lines; on bingyin of the sixth month in the fourteenth year (1221) Guihe was established as crown prince, renamed Gou, while the future emperor was made heir to the Prince of Yi.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，補秉義郎。

translations.literal: On yihai of the sixth month he was appointed Bearer of Righteousness Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the sixth month he was appointed Bearer of Righteousness Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，授右監門衛大將軍，賜名貴誠。

translations.literal: On jiazi of the eighth month he was appointed Grand General of the Right Gate Guard and granted the name Guicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the eighth month he was made Grand General of the Right Gate Guard and granted the name Guicheng.

sentences.zh: 十五年五月丁巳，以竑爲檢校少保，進封濟國公。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the fifth month in the fifteenth year, Gou was made acting Junior Guardian and advanced to Duke of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the fifth month in the fifteenth year of Jiading (1222), Gou was appointed acting Junior Guardian and promoted to Duke of Ji.

sentences.zh: 己未，以帝爲邵州防禦使。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the Emperor was appointed Defender of Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he was appointed Defender of Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 帝性凝重寡言，潔修好學，每朝參待漏，或多笑語，帝獨儼然。

translations.literal: The Emperor's nature was grave and taciturn; he loved purity and studied diligently; whenever courtiers waited for the dawn audience many would laugh and chat, but he alone remained solemn.
translations.idiomatic: The future emperor was by nature grave and sparing of words; he cherished purity and loved learning. Whenever the court assembled before dawn, others might jest and talk, but he alone sat in solemn stillness.

sentences.zh: 出入殿庭，矩度有常，見者斂容。

translations.literal: Entering and leaving the palace halls, his deportment was constant; those who saw him composed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Coming and going in the palace halls, his bearing was always measured; all who saw him straightened their demeanor.

sentences.zh: 會濟國公竑與丞相史彌遠有違言，彌遠日謀媒蘖其失于寧宗，屬意於帝而未遂。

translations.literal: At this time Duke of Ji Gou had words at odds with Chief Minister Shi Miyuan; Miyuan daily schemed to report Gou's faults to Ningzong and set his hopes on the Emperor but had not yet succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: About then Duke of Ji Gou fell out with Chief Minister Shi Miyuan, who daily plotted to bring Gou's faults before Ningzong while turning his hopes toward the future emperor—yet he had not yet succeeded.

sentences.zh: 十七年八月丙戌，寧宗違豫，自是不視朝。

translations.literal: On bingxu of the eighth month in the seventeenth year, Ningzong fell ill and from then on did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the eighth month in the seventeenth year of Jiading (1224), Ningzong took ill and thereafter ceased to hold court.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，疾篤，彌遠稱詔以貴誠爲皇子，改賜名昀，授武泰軍節度使，封成國公。

translations.literal: On renchen his illness grew severe; Miyuan claimed an edict making Guicheng crown prince, granting the name Yun, appointing Military Commissioner of Wutai Army, and enfeoffing him Duke of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the illness turned grave; Miyuan claimed an edict installing Guicheng as crown prince, granting the name Yun, appointing him Military Commissioner of the Wutai Army, and enfeoffing him Duke of Cheng.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙申，寧宗疾甚，丁酉，崩于福寧殿。

translations.literal: On bingshen of the intercalary month Ningzong's illness grew worse; on dingyou he died in the Hall of Serene Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of the intercalary month Ningzong grew critically ill; on dingyou he died in the Hall of Serene Governance.

sentences.zh: 彌遠使楊谷、楊石入白楊皇后，稱遺旨以皇子竑開府儀同三司，進封濟陽郡王、判寧國府，命子昀嗣皇帝位。

translations.literal: Miyuan sent Yang Gu and Yang Shi to inform Empress Yang, claiming the testamentary will made crown prince Gou Grand Preceptor with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, advanced to Prince of Jiyang and Administrator of Ningguo Prefecture, and ordered son Yun to succeed to the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: Miyuan sent Yang Gu and Yang Shi to report to Empress Yang, claiming the late emperor's will made crown prince Gou Grand Preceptor with honors equal to the Three Excellencies, promoted him to Prince of Jiyang with charge of Ningguo Prefecture, and ordered his son Yun to succeed to the throne.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 尊楊皇后曰皇太后，同聽政。

translations.literal: Empress Yang was honored as Empress Dowager and shared in government.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Yang was honored as Empress Dowager and joined in governing.

sentences.zh: 封竑爲濟王，賜第湖州，以醴泉觀使就第。

translations.literal: Gou was enfeoffed Prince of Ji, granted a mansion in Huzhou, and made to reside there as Superintendent of the Liquan Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: Gou was enfeoffed Prince of Ji, given a mansion in Huzhou, and sent to live there as Superintendent of the Liquan Abbey.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔宮中自服三年喪。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict ordered the palace to observe three years of mourning on its own.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict ordered the palace to observe the three-year mourning rites on its own.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，詔褒表老儒，以傅伯成爲顯謨閣學士，楊簡寶謨閣直學士，並提舉南京鴻慶宮。

translations.literal: On yihai of the ninth month, an edict commended venerable scholars: Fu Bocheng as Academician of the Hall for Manifest Instruction, Yang Jian as Direct Academician of the Hall for Cherished Instruction, both overseeing the Hongqing Palace at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the ninth month an edict honored aged scholars, appointing Fu Bocheng Academician of the Hall for Manifest Instruction and Yang Jian Direct Academician of the Hall for Cherished Instruction, both to oversee the Hongqing Palace at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 柴中行敘復元職，授右文殿修撰、主管南京鴻慶宮。

translations.literal: Chai Zhongxing was restored to his former rank and appointed Academician for Cultivating Culture in the Right Literary Hall, overseeing the Hongqing Palace at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: Chai Zhongxing was restored to his former office and made Academician for Cultivating Culture in the Right Literary Hall, overseeing the Hongqing Palace at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔兄濟王妻衛國夫人吳氏封許國夫人。

translations.literal: On wuyin, an edict enfeoffed the wife of the elder brother the Prince of Ji, Lady Wu of Weiguo, as Lady of Xuguo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict enfeoffed the Prince of Ji's wife, Lady Wu of Weiguo, as Lady of Xuguo.

sentences.zh: 己卯，皇太后、皇帝御便殿垂簾。

translations.literal: On jimao the Empress Dowager and Emperor held court behind the curtain at the side hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Empress Dowager and the Emperor held audience behind the curtain in the side hall.

sentences.zh: 詔以先聖四十九代孫行可爲迪功郎，授判、司、簿、尉；

translations.literal: An edict made the forty-ninth-generation descendant of the Sage Xing Ke a Di Gong Gentleman, appointing him to posts of administrator, registrar, or bailiff;
translations.idiomatic: An edict made the forty-ninth-generation descendant of Confucius, Xing Ke, a Di Gong Gentleman eligible for posts as administrator, registrar, or bailiff;

sentences.zh: 以禮部侍郎程珌、吏部侍郎朱著、中書舍人真德秀兼侍讀；

translations.literal: made Vice Minister of Rites Cheng Bi, Vice Minister of Personnel Zhu Zhuo, and Palace Draftsman Zhen Dexiu concurrent readers-in-waiting;
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Rites Cheng Bi, Vice Minister of Personnel Zhu Zhuo, and Palace Draftsman Zhen Dexiu were made concurrent readers-in-waiting;

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎葛洪、起居郎喬行簡、宗正少卿陳貴誼、軍器監王塈兼侍講。

translations.literal: made Vice Minister of Works Ge Hong, Attendant Ji Xingjian, Director of the Imperial Clan Chen Guiyi, and Superintendent of Armaments Wang Xi concurrent lecturers-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Works Ge Hong, Attendant Ji Xingjian, Director of the Imperial Clan Chen Guiyi, and Superintendent of Armaments Wang Xi were made concurrent lecturers-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 壬午，葛洪權工部尚書，升兼侍讀。

translations.literal: On renwu, Ge Hong was acting Minister of Works and promoted to concurrent reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Ge Hong was acting Minister of Works and promoted to concurrent reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinmao the Bright Hall was worshipped and a general amnesty proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Bright Hall was worshipped and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，詔諸路提點刑獄以十一月按理囚徒。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuxu, an edict ordered circuit intendants for penal affairs in every route to review prisoners in the eleventh month.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuxu, an edict ordered penal intendants on every circuit to review prisoners in the eleventh month.

sentences.zh: 己亥，嗣秀王師嵓薨。

translations.literal: On jihai, Heir to the Prince of Xiushi Wang Shiyan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Heir to the Prince of Xiushi, Wang Shiyan, died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔百官奉按月給。

translations.literal: On renzi, an edict ordered civil and military officials of every grade to receive monthly salaries on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict ordered civil and military officials of every grade to receive their monthly stipends on time.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，右正言麋溧請承順東朝，繼志述事，壹以孝宗爲法，而新政之切者，曰畏天、悅親、講學、仁民。

translations.literal: On jiazi of the eleventh month, Right Remonstrance Mi Li requested loyal compliance with the Eastern Palace, succession to his predecessor's work—take Xiaozong alone as model; the most pressing matters of the new administration were reverence for Heaven, pleasing kin, promoting learning, and benevolence toward the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the eleventh month Right Remonstrance Mi Li urged dutiful service to the Eastern Palace and faithful continuation of the late emperor's work, taking Emperor Xiaozong alone as the model; the urgent themes of the new reign were reverence for Heaven, delighting one's kin, promoting learning, and showing benevolence to the people.

sentences.zh: 上嘉納焉。

translations.literal: The throne commended and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised and adopted his counsel.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以五月十六日爲皇太后壽慶節。

translations.literal: On guwei, the sixteenth day of the fifth month was made the Empress Dowager's Birthday Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: On guwei the sixteenth day of the fifth month was established as the Empress Dowager's Birthday Celebration.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔改明年爲寶慶元年。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict changed the next year to the first year of Baoqing.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict changed the next year to the first year of Baoqing (1225).

sentences.zh: 戊子，以葛洪爲端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Ge Hong was made Academician of the Bright Hall and Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Ge Hong was made Academician of the Bright Hall and Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔以生日爲天基節。

translations.literal: On jichou, an edict made his birthday the Tianji Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict made the emperor's birthday the Tianji Festival.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，雪寒，免京城官私房賃地、門稅等錢。

translations.literal: On jiawu of the twelfth month, cold with snow—exempted from rent on government and private leased land in the capital, gate taxes, and similar levies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the twelfth month, amid snow and bitter cold, rent on government and private leased land in the capital, gate taxes, and similar charges were waived.

sentences.zh: 自是祥慶、災異、寒暑皆免。

translations.literal: From then on such exemptions applied for auspicious celebrations, disasters, and extremes of heat and cold.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth such waivers were granted for auspicious celebrations, disasters, and extremes of heat and cold.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，開經筵，詔輔臣觀講。

translations.literal: On guichou, the Classics Colloquium was opened; an edict ordered assisting ministers to attend the lectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the Classics Colloquium was opened, and an edict required assisting ministers to attend the lectures.

sentences.zh: 詔太后所居殿號曰慈明。

translations.literal: An edict named the Empress Dowager's residential hall Ciming ("Kind Brightness").
translations.idiomatic: An edict named the Empress Dowager's residential hall Ciming, "Kind Brightness."

sentences.zh: 辛酉，請大行皇帝諡號于南郊，諡曰仁文哲武恭孝皇帝，廟號曰寧宗。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the posthumous title of the late emperor was requested at the Southern Suburban Altar: Rencivil, Civically Martial, Respectfully Filial; temple name Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the posthumous title of the late emperor was sought at the Southern Suburban Altar: Rencivil, Civically Martial, Respectfully Filial; his temple name was Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，詔故太師、武勝定國軍節度使、鄂王岳飛諡忠武。

translations.literal: On jiawu of the second month, an edict posthumously titled the late Grand Preceptor, Military Commissioner of Wusheng and Dingguo Armies, Prince of E Yue Fei as Zhongwu ("Loyal Martial").
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the second month an edict posthumously titled the late Grand Preceptor, Military Commissioner of the Wusheng and Dingguo Armies, Prince of E Yue Fei as Zhongwu, "Loyal Martial."

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔師彌檢校少師、嗣秀王。

translations.literal: On bingshen, an edict made Shi Mi acting Junior Preceptor and Heir to the Prince of Xiushi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an edict made Shi Mi acting Junior Preceptor and Heir to the Prince of Xiushi.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，楚州火。

translations.literal: On bingchen, fire in Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Chuzhou suffered a fire.

sentences.zh: 戊午，發廩振在京細民，給犒馬步軍、皇城司守衛軍有差。

translations.literal: On wuwu, granaries were opened to relieve the poor in the capital; rewards in cash were given to infantry, cavalry, and Imperial Guard units by rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu granaries were opened to relieve the capital's poor; cash rewards were distributed to infantry, cavalry, and palace guard units according to rank.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，葬寧宗於會稽永茂陵。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the third month, Ningzong was buried at Yongmao Mausoleum in Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the third month Ningzong was buried at Yongmao Mausoleum in Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯朔，寧宗祔廟。

translations.literal: On xinmao, first day of the fourth month in summer, Ningzong was installed in the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the first day of the fourth month in summer, Ningzong was installed in the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔皇兄竑贈少師、保靜、鎮潼軍節度使，直舍人院王塈等繳奏命，遂寢。

translations.literal: On renchen, an edict offered the elder brother Gou posthumous Junior Preceptor and Military Commissioner of Baojing and Zhentong Armies; Attendant Wang Xi and others submitted a protest against the appointment, and it was withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict offered the emperor's elder brother Gou posthumous Junior Preceptor and Military Commissioner of the Baojing and Zhentong Armies; Attendant Wang Xi and others protested the appointment, and it was set aside.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，皇太后手書：「多病，自今免垂簾聽政。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Empress Dowager wrote by hand: "I am often ill; from now on I shall not hold court behind the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Empress Dowager wrote in her own hand: "I am often ill; from now on I shall not hold court behind the curtain."

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，帝兩請皇太后垂簾，不允。

translations.literal: On renyin the Emperor twice requested that the Empress Dowager resume the curtain; she did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Emperor twice asked the Empress Dowager to resume the curtain; she did not agree.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，發廩振在京細民。

translations.literal: On xinhai, granaries were opened to relieve the poor in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai granaries were opened to relieve the capital's poor.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，詔：「內外文武大小之臣，于國政有所見聞，封章來上，毋或有隱。

translations.literal: On jiazi of the fifth month, an edict: "Civil and military officials great and small, when they have observations on state affairs, may submit sealed memorials without concealment."
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the fifth month an edict declared: "Civil and military officials great and small, whenever they have observations on state affairs, may submit sealed memorials without holding anything back."

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，詔不熄爲保康軍承宣使、嗣濮王。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict made Bu Xi Grand Commissioner of the Baokang Army and Heir to the Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict made Bu Xi Grand Commissioner of the Baokang Army and Heir to the Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On xinmao of the sixth month, the Metal Star was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the sixth month the Metal Star (Venus) was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔史彌遠爲太師，依前右丞相兼樞密使，進封魏國公。

translations.literal: On dingwei, an edict made Shi Miyuan Grand Preceptor, retaining his posts as Right Chancellor and Commissioner of Military Affairs, and advanced him Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei an edict made Shi Miyuan Grand Preceptor while retaining his posts as Right Chancellor and Commissioner of Military Affairs, and promoted him to Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 彌遠辭免太師。

translations.literal: Miyuan declined the Grand Preceptorship.
translations.idiomatic: Miyuan declined the Grand Preceptorship.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，滁州大水，詔振恤之。

translations.literal: On dingchou of the seventh month in autumn, great flood in Chuzhou; an edict ordered relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the seventh month in autumn Chuzhou suffered a great flood, and an edict ordered relief.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔行大宋元寶錢。

translations.literal: On yiyou, an edict ordered circulation of the Dayuan Yuanbao coin.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict ordered circulation of the Dayuan Yuanbao coin.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，以司農丞姚子才封事切直，詔進一秩，授秘書郎。

translations.literal: On renyin of the eighth month, because the memorial of Director of Agriculture Yao Zicai was blunt and forthright, an edict advanced him one rank and appointed him Secretary Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the eighth month, because Director of Agriculture Yao Zicai's memorial was blunt and forthright, an edict advanced him one rank and appointed him Secretary Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔知袁州趙䈣夫直秘閣、福建提點刑獄，以旌廉吏。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict made Zhao Moufu, prefect of Yuanzhou, Direct Academician of the Secretariat and Fujian penal intendant, to reward an incorrupt official.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict made Zhao Moufu, prefect of Yuanzhou, Direct Academician of the Secretariat and Fujian penal intendant, to honor an incorrupt official.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔侍從、給諫、卿監、郎官，並在外前執政、侍從、帥臣、監司，各舉廉吏三人。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, remonstrators and censors, directors and vice-directors, and outer former chancellors, attendants, circuit commissioners and supervisors each to recommend three incorrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu an edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, remonstrators and censors, directors and vice-directors, and former chancellors and attendants at court or in the provinces, together with circuit commissioners and supervisors, each to recommend three incorrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔侍從、兩省、台諫、三衙、知閣、御帶、環衛官，在外前執政、侍從，帥臣、監司、都副都統制及屯戍主將，其各舉堪充將帥三人。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict ordered attendants, both provincial bureaus, censorate, three commands, directors of inner service, imperial guard officers, and outer former chancellors, attendants, commanders, supervisors, deputy commissioners, and garrison commanders each to recommend three men fit for generalship.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict ordered attendants, both provincial bureaus, the censorate, the three commands, directors of inner service, imperial guard officers, and former chancellors and attendants at court or in the provinces, together with commanders, supervisors, deputy commissioners, and garrison commanders, each to recommend three men fit to command armies.

sentences.zh: 己酉，地震。

translations.literal: On jiyou, an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 壬子，張九成贈太師，追封崇國公，諡文忠。

translations.literal: On renzi, Zhang Jiucheng was posthumously made Grand Preceptor, enfeoffed Duke of Chong, posthumous name Wenzong.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Zhang Jiucheng was posthumously made Grand Preceptor, enfeoffed Duke of Chong, with posthumous name Wenzong.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以程頤四世孫源爲籍田令。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Cheng Yi's fourth-generation descendant Yuan was made director of the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Cheng Yi's fourth-generation descendant Yuan was made director of the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，莫澤言真德秀舛論綱常，簡節上語，曲爲濟王地。

translations.literal: On yimao, Mo Ze said Zhen Dexiu had perverse discourse on the bonds of human relations, abbreviated his words to the throne, and bent them to favor the Prince of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Mo Ze charged that Zhen Dexiu had perverse discourse on the bonds of human relations, that he abbreviated his words to the throne, and that he bent them to favor the Prince of Ji.

sentences.zh: 詔德秀煥章閣待制、提舉玉隆萬壽宮。

translations.literal: An edict made Dexiu Huanzhang Hall Gentleman-in-waiting and Superintendent of the Yulong Wanshou Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Dexiu Huanzhang Hall Gentleman-in-waiting and Superintendent of the Yulong Wanshou Abbey.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔戒貪吏。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an edict warned against grasping officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi an edict warned against grasping officials.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，著作佐郎陶崇上保業、慎獨、謹微、持久四事，帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: On bingyin of the ninth month, Assistant Compiler Tao Chong presented four matters—preserving the enterprise, cautious solitude, strict vigilance, and endurance; the Emperor commended and accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the ninth month Assistant Compiler Tao Chong presented four counsels—preserving the enterprise, cautious solitude, strict vigilance, and endurance; the Emperor praised and adopted them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: On guisi of the tenth month in winter, a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the tenth month in winter a meteor as large as the Great White Star (Venus) appeared.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔會稽欑宮所在，稅賦盡免折科，山陰縣權免三年。

translations.literal: On jiayin, an edict exempted all tax levies and commuted grain quotas in the area of Kuaiji's imperial mausoleum; Shanyin County was provisionally exempted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin an edict exempted all tax levies and commuted grain quotas in the area of Kuaiji's imperial mausoleum; Shanyin County was provisionally exempted for three years.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，宣繒兼同知樞密院事，薛極參知政事，葛洪簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On guihai of the eleventh month, Xuan Jian was concurrently Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs, Xue Ji Vice Commissioner of the Council, Ge Hong Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai of the eleventh month Xuan Jian was concurrently Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs, Xue Ji Vice Commissioner of the Council, and Ge Hong Commissioner of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔邵州潛藩，可升爲寶慶府。

translations.literal: An edict: the submerged fief of Shaozhou could be promoted to Baoqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that the emperor's former submerged fief of Shaozhou could be elevated to Baoqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 筠州與御名音相近，改爲瑞州。

translations.literal: Junzhou was close in sound to the emperor's personal name and was renamed Ruizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Junzhou was close in sound to the emperor's personal name and was renamed Ruizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，雪寒，在京諸軍給緡錢有差，出戍之家倍之。

translations.literal: On renwu, cold with snow—in the capital, cash grants to the various armies by rank; households of troops on garrison duty received double.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, amid snow and bitter cold, cash grants were issued to the capital's armies by rank; households of troops on garrison duty received double.

sentences.zh: 自是祥慶、災異、霪雨、雪寒鹹給。

translations.literal: From then on such grants were made for auspicious celebrations, disasters, heavy rain, and cold with snow.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth such grants were made for auspicious celebrations, disasters, heavy rain, and snow with bitter cold.

sentences.zh: 甲申，朱端常言魏了翁封章謗訕，真德秀奏劄誣詆。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Zhu Duanchang said Wei Liaoweng's sealed memorials were slanderous, and Zhen Dexiu's submissions were abusive calumny.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhu Duanchang charged that Wei Liaoweng's sealed memorials were slanderous and that Zhen Dexiu's submissions were abusive calumny.

sentences.zh: 詔魏了翁落職，奪三秩、靖州居住；

translations.literal: An edict stripped Wei Liaoweng of office, reduced three ranks, and ordered residence in Jingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Wei Liaoweng of office, reduced him three ranks, and ordered him to reside in Jingzhou;

sentences.zh: 真德秀落職罷祠。

translations.literal: Dexiu was stripped of office and dismissed from his sinecure post.
translations.idiomatic: Dexiu was stripped of office and dismissed from his sinecure post.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，詔刪修敕令。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the twelfth month, an edict ordered revision of statutes and ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the twelfth month an edict ordered revision of statutes and ordinances.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩浙路戶一百九十七萬五千九百九十六，口二百八十二萬二千三十二。

translations.literal: That year the Two Zhe Circuits had 1,975,996 households and 2,822,032 mouths.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Two Zhe Circuits registered 1,975,996 households and 2,822,032 mouths.

sentences.zh: 福建路戶一百七十萬四千一百八十六，口二百五十五萬三千七十九。

translations.literal: The Fujian Circuit had 1,704,186 households and 2,553,079 mouths.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian Circuit had 1,704,186 households and 2,553,079 mouths.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸亥，詔贈沈煥、陸九齡官，煥諡端憲，九齡諡文達。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the second year on guihai, an edict posthumously conferred office on Shen Huan and Lu Jiuling; Huan posthumous Duanduan, Jiuling Wendda.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the second year, on guihai, an edict posthumously conferred office on Shen Huan and Lu Jiuling; Huan received the posthumous name Duanduan, Jiuling Wendda.

sentences.zh: 錄張九成、呂祖謙、張栻、陸九淵子孫官各有差。

translations.literal: The sons and grandsons of Zhang Jiucheng, Lu Zuqian, Zhang Shi, and Lu Jiuyuan were granted offices each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: The sons and grandsons of Zhang Jiucheng, Lu Zuqian, Zhang Shi, and Lu Jiuyuan were granted offices, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔布衣李心傳赴闕。

translations.literal: On guiyou, an edict summoned the commoner Li Xinchuan to court.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict summoned the commoner Li Xinchuan to court.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，熒惑入氐。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Mars entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Mars entered the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太白、歲星、填星合於女。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Great White Star, Jupiter, and Saturn conjoined in Nü.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Great White Star, Jupiter, and Saturn conjoined in the mansion Nü.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，臨察御史梁成大言真德秀有大惡五，僅褫職罷祠，罰輕。

translations.literal: On xinmao of the second month, Supervising Censor Liang Chengda said Zhen Dexiu had five great evils; merely stripping office and dismissing his sinecure was too light a penalty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the second month Supervising Censor Liang Chengda charged that Zhen Dexiu had five great evils and that merely stripping office and dismissing his sinecure was too light a penalty.

sentences.zh: 詔削二秩。

translations.literal: An edict reduced two more ranks.
translations.idiomatic: An edict reduced him two more ranks.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，以久雨，詔大理寺、三衙、兩浙運司、臨安府諸屬縣榷酒所，凡贓賞等錢，罪已決者，一切勿征，毋錮留妻子。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the third month, because of prolonged rain, an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, three commands, Two-Zhe transport commission, Lin'an prefecture, and subordinate counties' wine monopolies—wherever fine and reward monies had been decided after judgment, not to collect them and not to detain wives and children.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the third month, because of prolonged rain, an edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review, the three commands, the Two-Zhe transport commission, the Lin'an prefectural government, and subordinate counties' wine monopolies that wherever fine and reward monies had been decided after judgment, they should not be collected and wives and children should not be detained.

sentences.zh: 自是霖潦、寒暑皆免。

translations.literal: From then on such exemption applied for flood and rain, floodwater, and extremes of heat and cold.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth such exemption applied for flood rains, inundation, and extremes of heat and cold.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔太常寺建功臣閣，以「昭勳崇德」爲名。

translations.literal: On wuyin, an edict ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to build a Pavilion of Meritorious Ministers, named "Illustrious Merit and Esteemed Virtue."
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to build a Pavilion of Meritorious Ministers named "Illustrious Merit and Esteemed Virtue."

sentences.zh: 己卯，蘄州火。

translations.literal: On jimao, fire in Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Qizhou suffered a fire.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，詔輔臣奉薄，其以《隆興格》爲制。

translations.literal: On jichou of the fourth month in summer, an edict: assisting ministers' stipends were meager; take the Longxing regulations as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the fourth month in summer an edict declared that assisting ministers' stipends were meager and that the Longxing regulations should serve as the standard.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: On xinhai, a meteor as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，御後殿，賜進士王會龍以下九百八十九人及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On bingshen of the sixth month, the throne held court in the rear hall and bestowed jinshi degrees and ranked passes on Wang Huilong and 988 others with differences in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of the sixth month the emperor held court in the rear hall and granted jinshi degrees and ranked passes to Wang Huilong and 988 others, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔以孔子五十二代孫萬春襲封衍聖公。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict made Confucius's fifty-second-generation descendant Wanchun inherit the enfeoffment as Duke Yansheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict had Confucius's fifty-second-generation descendant Wanchun inherit the title Duke Yansheng.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，雷。

translations.literal: On gengshen of the ninth month, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the ninth month there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，詔《寧宗御集》閣以「寶章」爲名，仍置學士、待制員。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the tenth month in winter, an edict named the pavilion for the Collected Writings of Ningzong "Baozhang" and established posts for academicians and gentlemen-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the tenth month in winter an edict named the pavilion housing the Collected Writings of Ningzong "Baozhang" and established posts for its academicians and gentlemen-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，又雷。

translations.literal: On xinchou, thunder again.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou thunder struck again.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，熒惑、歲星、填星合於女，熒惑犯填星。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn conjoined in Nü; Mars encroached on Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn conjoined in the mansion Nü, and Mars encroached on Saturn.

sentences.zh: 改湖州爲安吉州。

translations.literal: Huzhou was changed to Anji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Huzhou was elevated to Anji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，修祚德廟，以嚴程嬰、公孫杵臼之祀。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the eleventh month, the Zuode Temple was repaired for the sacrifices to Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chajiu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the eleventh month the Zuode Temple was repaired to maintain the sacrifices to Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chajiu.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，始御紫宸殿。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the emperor first held court in the Hall of Purple Serenity.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the emperor first held court in the Hall of Purple Serenity.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，熒惑犯歲星。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Mars encroached on Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Mars encroached on Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 丙子，日南至，上詣慈明殿。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the winter solstice; the emperor went to the Hall of Ciming.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the winter solstice, the emperor went to the Hall of Ciming.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，親享太廟。

translations.literal: On guimao of the twelfth month, the emperor personally worshipped at the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the twelfth month the emperor personally offered sacrifice at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛亥朔，上壽明皇太后尊號冊、寶於慈明殿。

translations.literal: On xinhai, first day of the first month in spring in the third year, the honorific title and seal of the Empress Dowager Shouming were presented at the Hall of Ciming.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the first day of the first month in spring in the third year, the honorific title and imperial seal for Empress Dowager Shouming were presented at the Hall of Ciming.

sentences.zh: 壬子，史彌遠進二秩。

translations.literal: On renzi, Shi Miyuan was advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Shi Miyuan was advanced two ranks.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以楊谷、楊石並爲少傅。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Yang Gu and Yang Shi were both made Junior Preceptors.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Yang Gu and Yang Shi were both appointed Junior Preceptors.

sentences.zh: 知楚州姚翀朝辭，奏淮楚忠義軍事，上曰：「南北皆吾赤子，何分彼此，卿其爲朕撫定之。

translations.literal: Yao Chong of Chuzhou, on farewell audience, reported on loyal and righteous military affairs in the Huai region; the emperor said: "North and south are alike my children—why distinguish them? See that you pacify them for me.
translations.idiomatic: At his farewell audience Yao Chong, prefect of Chuzhou, reported on loyal and righteous military affairs along the Huai; the emperor said, "North and south alike are my children—why make distinctions? See that you bring them peace for me.

sentences.zh: 」己巳，詔：「朕觀朱熹集注《大學》、《論語》、《孟子》、《中庸》，發揮聖賢蘊奧，有補治道，朕勵志講學，緬懷典刑，可特贈熹太師，追封信國公。

translations.literal: On jisi, an edict: "We have read Zhu Xi's collected commentaries on the Great Learning, Analects, Mencius, and Doctrine of the Mean, elucidating the profundities of the sages and worthies and aiding governance; We are resolved to pursue learning and cherish their example, and therefore specially posthumously grant Xi the title Grand Preceptor and enfeoff him Duke of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an edict declared: "We have read Zhu Xi's collected commentaries on the Great Learning, the Analects, Mencius, and the Doctrine of the Mean, which unfold the profundities of the sages and aid the way of governance; We are resolved to pursue learning and cherish their example, and therefore specially posthumously grant Xi the title Grand Preceptor and enfeoff him Duke of Xin.

sentences.zh: 」三月庚戌朔，詔郡縣長吏勸農桑，抑末作，戒苛擾。

translations.literal: On gengxu, first day of the third month, an edict ordered prefectural and county chief officials to encourage farming and sericulture, restrain secondary occupations, and warn against harsh harassment.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the first day of the third month, an edict ordered prefectural and county chiefs to encourage farming and sericulture, restrain secondary trades, and warn against harsh harassment.

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎朱在進對，奏人主學問之要，上曰：「先卿《中庸序》言之甚詳，朕讀之不釋手，恨不與同時。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Works Zhu Zai, on entering audience, presented the essentials of the ruler's learning; the emperor said: "My late father's preface to the Doctrine of the Mean explains it very fully; I read it without setting it down and regret that we were not contemporaries.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Works Zhu Zai, on entering audience, presented the essentials of the ruler's learning; the emperor said, "My late father's preface to the Doctrine of the Mean explains the matter very fully; I read it without setting it aside and regret that we were not contemporaries.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，以皇太后尊號冊、寶禮成，侄孫楊鳳孫以下推恩有差。

translations.literal: On xinhai, because the rites for the Empress Dowager's honorific title and seal were completed, the emperor's grandnephew Yang Fengsun and others received graded favors.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, because the rites for the Empress Dowager's honorific title and seal were completed, the emperor's grandnephew Yang Fengsun and others received graded favors.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，宣引前丞相謝深甫孫女謝氏詣慈明殿進見。

translations.literal: On wuxu of the fourth month in summer, the former chief minister Xie Shenfu's granddaughter Lady Xie was introduced at the Hall of Ciming.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the fourth month in summer the former chief minister Xie Shenfu's granddaughter Lady Xie was introduced at the Hall of Ciming.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，詔岳珂戶部侍郎，依前淮東總領兼制置使。

translations.literal: On renzi of the fifth month, an edict made Yue Ke Vice Minister of Revenue, retaining his former posts as Huaidong chief commissioner and pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the fifth month an edict made Yue Ke Vice Minister of Revenue while retaining his former posts as Huaidong chief commissioner and pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 閏月己卯朔，詔：郡縣系囚不實書曆，未經結錄，守臣輒行特判，憲司其詳覆所部獄案，歲月淹延者重置於憲。

translations.literal: On jimao, first day of the intercalary month, an edict: prisoners registered by prefectures and counties who had not been entered in the calendar or concluded in record—if guarding officials rashly passed special judgments, the surveillance commission should review penal cases in its jurisdiction in detail; those delayed for months should be heavily penalized within the commission.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the first day of the intercalary month, an edict declared that where prisoners in prefectural and county custody had not been entered in the calendar or concluded in record, if guarding officials rashly passed special judgments, the surveillance commission should review penal cases in its jurisdiction in detail, and those delayed for months should be heavily penalized within the commission.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On wushen, first day of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the first day of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，太陰犯心。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the seventh month in autumn, the moon encroached on the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the seventh month in autumn the moon encroached on the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔振贍被水郡縣，其竹木等稅勿征。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict ordered relief for flood-stricken prefectures and counties; taxes on bamboo, timber, and the like were not to be collected.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict ordered relief for flood-stricken prefectures and counties; taxes on bamboo, timber, and the like were not to be collected.

sentences.zh: 丙午，史彌遠乞歸田裏，詔不允。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Shi Miyuan requested to return to his rural estate; an edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Shi Miyuan asked to retire to his rural estate; an edict did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，詔謝氏特封通義郡夫人。

translations.literal: On gengxu of the eighth month, an edict specially enfeoffed Lady Xie as Lady of Tongyi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the eighth month an edict specially enfeoffed Lady Xie as Lady of Tongyi.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔凡試邑兩經罷黜，更勿授知縣、縣令。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict: whoever twice failed examination for a magistracy should never again be appointed prefect or county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict declared that whoever twice failed the examination for a magistracy should never again be appointed prefect or county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太白、熒惑合於翼。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Great White Star and Mars conjoined in Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Great White Star and Mars conjoined in the mansion Yi.

sentences.zh: 丙子，城太平州，詔知州綦奎進中奉大夫，余推恩有差。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Taiping Prefecture was fortified; an edict advanced Prefect Qi Kui to Grand Master of Palace Provision, with graded favors for the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Taiping Prefecture was fortified; an edict advanced Prefect Qi Kui to Grand Master of Palace Provision, with graded favors for the others.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，故觀文殿大學士、魏國公、贈太師留正諡忠宣。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the late Grand Master of the Hall for Observing Culture, Duke of Wei, posthumously Grand Preceptor Liu Zheng received the posthumous name Zhongxuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the late Grand Master of the Hall for Observing Culture, Duke of Wei, posthumously Grand Preceptor Liu Zheng, received the posthumous name Zhongxuan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，追上寧宗徽號曰法天備道純德茂功仁文哲武聖睿恭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the late Ningzong's honorific title was advanced: Fatiian, Beidao, Chunde, Maogong, Rencivil, Zhewu, Shengrui, Gongxiao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the late Ningzong's honorific title was advanced to Fatiian, Beidao, Chunde, Maogong, Rencivil, Zhewu, Shengrui, Gongxiao.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，右監門衛大將軍與奭改賜名貴謙，授宜州觀察使，繼沂王后。

translations.literal: On jiazi of the tenth month in winter, Grand General of the Right Gate Guard Yu Shi was granted the name Guiqian and appointed Military Commissioner of Yizhou, succeeding as heir to the Prince of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the tenth month in winter Grand General of the Right Gate Guard Yu Shi was granted the name Guiqian and appointed Military Commissioner of Yizhou, succeeding as heir to the Prince of Yi.

sentences.zh: 右千牛衛將軍孟杓改賜名乃裕，授和州防禦使，繼景獻太子後。

translations.literal: Grand General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard Meng Biao was granted the name Naiyu and appointed Defender of Hezhou, succeeding as heir to the Jingxian Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard Meng Biao was granted the name Naiyu and appointed Defender of Hezhou, succeeding as heir to the Jingxian Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，趙范江東提刑兼知池州，節制防江水步軍、池州都統司軍馬。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Zhao Fan was Jiangdong penal intendant and concurrently prefect of Chizhou, commanding river-defense infantry and cavalry and the Chizhou commandery forces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Zhao Fan was Jiangdong penal intendant and concurrently prefect of Chizhou, commanding river-defense infantry and cavalry and the Chizhou commandery forces.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，奉上寧宗徽號冊寶於太廟。

translations.literal: On wuyin of the eleventh month, Ningzong's honorific title and seal were presented at the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the eleventh month Ningzong's honorific title and seal were presented at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，日南至，郊，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the winter solstice; suburban sacrifice; general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the winter solstice, the suburban sacrifice was performed and a general amnesty proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 改明年爲紹定元年。

translations.literal: The next year was changed to the first year of Shaoding.
translations.idiomatic: The next year was changed to the first year of Shaoding.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，日旁有氣如珥。

translations.literal: On jiyou of the twelfth month, vapor like ear pendants appeared beside the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the twelfth month vapor like ear pendants appeared beside the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬申，發廩振贍京城細民。

translations.literal: On renshen, granaries were opened to relieve the capital's poor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen granaries were opened to relieve the capital's poor.

sentences.zh: 大元兵破關外諸隘，四川制置鄭損棄三關。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops broke the passes beyond the frontier; Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Zheng Sun abandoned the three passes.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan troops broke the frontier passes; Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Zheng Sun abandoned the three passes.

sentences.zh: 紹定元年春正月丙子朔，上壽明慈睿皇太后尊號冊寶於慈明殿。

translations.literal: On bingzi, first day of the first month in spring in the first year of Shaoding, the honorific title and seal of Empress Dowager Shouming Ciru were presented at the Hall of Ciming.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the first day of the first month in spring in the first year of Shaoding, the honorific title and seal for Empress Dowager Shouming Ciru were presented at the Hall of Ciming.

sentences.zh: 楊谷、楊石並升少師。

translations.literal: Yang Gu and Yang Shi were both promoted to Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Gu and Yang Shi were both promoted to Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On renyin, first day of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the first day of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己酉，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: On jiyou, a meteor fell by day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou a meteor fell by day.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: On wuxu of the seventh month in autumn, Mars encroached on the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the seventh month in autumn Mars encroached on the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，熒惑犯壁壘陣星。

translations.literal: On wushen of the tenth month in winter, Mars encroached on the Rampart Formation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the tenth month in winter Mars encroached on the Rampart Formation.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，熒惑、填星合于危。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Mars and Saturn conjoined in Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Mars and Saturn conjoined in the mansion Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲子，熒惑犯填星。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Mars encroached on Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Mars encroached on Saturn.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，熒惑入羽林。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the eleventh month, Mars entered the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the eleventh month Mars entered the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，雷。

translations.literal: On gengchen, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔申嚴皇城司給符之制，照闌入法。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict strictly enforced the Imperial City Office's system of issuing passes, applying the law on unlawful entry.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict strictly enforced the Imperial City Office's system of issuing passes, applying the law on unlawful entry.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，以薛極知樞密院事兼參知政事，葛洪參知政事，袁韶同知樞密院事，鄭清之端明殿學士、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the twelfth month, Xue Ji was made Commissioner of Military Affairs and Vice Commissioner of the Council; Ge Hong Vice Commissioner of the Council; Yuan Shao Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs; Zheng Qingzhi Academician of the Bright Hall and Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the twelfth month Xue Ji was made Commissioner of Military Affairs and Vice Commissioner of the Council; Ge Hong Vice Commissioner of the Council; Yuan Shao Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs; and Zheng Qingzhi Academician of the Bright Hall and Commissioner of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚辰，大理司直張衍上檢驗、推鞠四事。

translations.literal: On gengchen of the first month in spring in the second year, Directing Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review Zhang Yan presented four matters on inspection and interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen of the first month in spring in the second year Directing Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review Zhang Yan presented four matters on inspection and interrogation.

sentences.zh: 詔刑獄人命所關，其令有司究行之。

translations.literal: An edict: because criminal cases touch human lives, ordered the responsible offices to investigate and implement them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that because criminal cases touch human lives, the responsible offices should investigate and implement the proposals.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，熒惑、歲星合于婁。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Mars and Jupiter conjoined in Lou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Mars and Jupiter conjoined in the mansion Lou.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，詔歲舉廉吏或犯奸贓，保任同坐，監司、守臣其申嚴覺察。

translations.literal: On gengxu of the second month, an edict: when annually recommended incorrupt officials later commit graft, the recommending and supervising officials share guilt; circuit commissioners and prefects should strictly watch and report.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the second month an edict declared that when annually recommended incorrupt officials later commit graft, the recommending and supervising officials share guilt, and circuit commissioners and prefects should strictly watch and report.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，詔郡縣系囚多瘐死獄中，憲司其具獄官姓名以聞，黜罷之。

translations.literal: On xinmao of the third month, an edict: because many prisoners in prefectures and counties died of illness in jail, the surveillance commission should report the names of jail officials for dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the third month an edict declared that because many prisoners in prefectures and counties died of illness in jail, the surveillance commission should report jail officials' names for dismissal.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，詔郡縣官闕，毋令藝術人、豪民、罷吏借補權攝。

translations.literal: On gengshen of the fourth month in summer, an edict: when prefectural and county posts were vacant, artisans, powerful locals, and dismissed officials must not be lent to fill them on a provisional basis.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the fourth month in summer an edict declared that when prefectural and county posts were vacant, artisans, powerful locals, and dismissed officials must not be lent to fill them provisionally.

sentences.zh: 五月，詔成都、潼川路歲旱民歉，制司、監司其亟振恤，仍察郡縣奉令勤惰以聞。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, an edict: because drought in the Chengdu and Tongchuan circuits brought famine, pacification and supervisory offices should urgently relieve and report whether prefectures and counties obeyed diligently or slackly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month an edict declared that because drought in the Chengdu and Tongchuan circuits brought famine, pacification and supervisory offices should urgently relieve the people and report whether prefectures and counties obeyed diligently or slackly.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賜進士黃朴以下五百五十七人及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On xinsi, jinshi degrees and ranked passes were bestowed on Huang Pu and 556 others with differences in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi jinshi degrees and ranked passes were granted to Huang Pu and 556 others, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 詔戶絕者許立嗣，毋妄籍沒。

translations.literal: An edict: where households had no heirs, adoption was permitted; property must not be seized without cause.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that where households had no heirs, adoption was permitted and property must not be seized without cause.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，詔通義郡夫人謝氏進封美人。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the sixth month, an edict advanced Lady Xie of Tongyi to Beautiful Person.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the sixth month an edict advanced Lady Xie of Tongyi to Beautiful Person.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，台州大水。

translations.literal: On dingmao of the ninth month, great flood in Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the ninth month Taizhou suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: On renchen, a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，詔台州水災，除民田租及茶、鹽、酒酤諸雜稅，郡縣抑納者監司察之。

translations.literal: On renxu of the tenth month in winter, an edict: because of Taizhou's flood disaster, exempted field rent and miscellaneous taxes on tea, salt, and wine; surveillance commissioners should investigate prefectures and counties that pressed collection.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the tenth month in winter an edict declared that because of Taizhou's flood disaster, field rent and miscellaneous taxes on tea, salt, and wine were waived, and surveillance commissioners should investigate prefectures and counties that pressed collection.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑，熒惑入氐。

translations.literal: On jichou of the eleventh month, Mars entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the eleventh month Mars entered the mansion Di.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲申，詔故皇子緝贈保信、奉國軍節度使，開府儀同三司，追封永王，諡沖安。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the first month in spring in the third year, an edict posthumously granted the late prince Ji Military Commissioner of Baoxin and Fengguo Armies, Grand Preceptor with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, enfeoffed him Prince of Yong, posthumous name Chong'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the first month in spring in the third year an edict posthumously granted the late prince Ji Military Commissioner of the Baoxin and Fengguo Armies, Grand Preceptor with honors equal to the Three Excellencies, enfeoffed him Prince of Yong, with posthumous name Chong'an.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，知棗陽軍史嵩之創置屯田，以勞賞官兩轉。

translations.literal: On renchen, Shi Songzhi, military commander of Zaoyang, established military colonies; for his labor he was rewarded with two promotions in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Shi Songzhi, military commander of Zaoyang, established military colonies; for his labor he was rewarded with two promotions in rank.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，日有背氣。

translations.literal: On bingshen of the second month, a corona appeared on the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of the second month a corona appeared on the sun.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔汀、贛、吉、建昌蠻獠竊發，經擾郡縣復賦稅一年。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict: because Miao and Liao raiders had risen in Ting, Gan, Ji, and Jianchang, the taxed prefectures and counties they had ravaged were granted one year's remission.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict declared that because Miao and Liao raiders had risen in Ting, Gan, Ji, and Jianchang, the taxed prefectures and counties they had ravaged were granted one year's remission.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔趙範起復，依前知鎮江府、節制防江水步並本州在砦軍馬；

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict recalled Zhao Fan to office, retaining his former posts as prefect of Zhenjiang and commander of river-defense infantry and cavalry and garrison forces of that prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu an edict recalled Zhao Fan to office, retaining his former posts as prefect of Zhenjiang and commander of river-defense infantry and cavalry and the garrison forces of that prefecture;

sentences.zh: 趙葵起復，依前知滁州、節制本州屯戍軍馬。

translations.literal: Zhao Kui was recalled to office, retaining his former posts as prefect of Chuzhou and commander of that prefecture's garrison forces.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Kui was recalled to office, retaining his former posts as prefect of Chuzhou and commander of that prefecture's garrison forces.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔故皇子繹賜忠正、保寧軍節度使、開府儀同三司，追封昭王，諡沖純。

translations.literal: On renzi, an edict posthumously granted the late prince Yi Military Commissioner of Zhongzheng and Baoning Armies, Grand Preceptor with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies, enfeoffed him Prince of Zhao, posthumous name Chongchun.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict posthumously granted the late prince Yi Military Commissioner of the Zhongzheng and Baoning Armies, Grand Preceptor with honors equal to the Three Excellencies, enfeoffed him Prince of Zhao, with posthumous name Chongchun.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸酉，逃卒穆椿夜竊入皇城，燒毀甲仗，衛士捕得之，詔磔於市。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the intercalary month, the deserter Mu Chun by night secretly entered the Imperial City and burned armor and weapons; guards captured him, and an edict ordered him dismembered in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the intercalary month the deserter Mu Chun by night secretly entered the Imperial City and burned armor and weapons; guards captured him, and an edict ordered him dismembered in the market.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太白、歲星合于畢。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the Great White Star and Jupiter conjoined in Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Great White Star and Jupiter conjoined in the mansion Bi.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，雨土。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the third month, dust fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the third month dust rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 戊申，奉國軍節度使不忄冬薨，贈少傅，追封樂平郡王。

translations.literal: On wushen, Military Commissioner of Fengguo Army Bu Xi died; posthumously made Junior Preceptor and enfeoffed Prince of Leping.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Military Commissioner of the Fengguo Army Bu Xi died; he was posthumously made Junior Preceptor and enfeoffed Prince of Leping.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，漳州、連城盜起，知龍岩縣莊夢詵、尉鐘自強不能效死守土，詔各削二秩罷。

translations.literal: On jimao of the fourth month in summer, bandits rose in Zhangzhou and Liancheng; Longyan magistrate Zhuang Mengshen and bailiff Zhong Ziqiang could not hold the soil in loyal defense; an edict reduced each two ranks and dismissed them.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the fourth month in summer bandits rose in Zhangzhou and Liancheng; Longyan magistrate Zhuang Mengshen and bailiff Zhong Ziqiang could not hold the territory in loyal defense; an edict reduced each two ranks and dismissed them.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，檢校少保李全授彰、化保康軍節度使，開府儀同三司、京東鎮撫使，依舊京東忠義諸軍都統制。

translations.literal: On jiayin of the fifth month, acting Junior Guardian Li Quan was appointed Military Commissioner of Zhang, Hua, and Baokang Armies, Grand Preceptor with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies and Huaidong Pacification Commissioner, retaining his former post as commander of all loyalist forces in Huaidong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin of the fifth month acting Junior Guardian Li Quan was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhang, Hua, and Baokang Armies, Grand Preceptor with honors equal to the Three Excellencies and Huaidong Pacification Commissioner, retaining his former post as commander of all loyalist forces in Huaidong.

sentences.zh: 戊午，李全左右金吾衛上將軍，職任仍舊。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Li Quan was made General-in-chief of the Left Golden Crow Guard; his duties remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Li Quan was made General-in-chief of the Left Golden Crow Guard; his duties remained as before.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，歲星入井。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the sixth month, Jupiter entered Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the sixth month Jupiter entered the mansion Jing.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，汀州寧化縣曾氏寡婦晏給軍糧禦漳寇有功，又全活鄉民數萬人，詔封恭人，賜冠帔，官其子承信郎。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the seventh month in autumn, in Ninghua County, Tingzhou, the widow Yan of the Zeng clan supplied army grain to resist Zhang bandits with merit and also saved tens of thousands of villagers; an edict enfeoffed her Lady Gongren, bestowed cap and robe, and granted her son the rank of Gentleman for Trust.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the seventh month in autumn, in Ninghua County, Tingzhou, the widow Yan of the Zeng clan supplied army grain to resist Zhang bandits with merit and also saved tens of thousands of villagers; an edict enfeoffed her Lady Gongren, bestowed cap and robe, and granted her son the rank of Gentleman for Trust.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinchou of the ninth month, the Bright Hall was worshipped; general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the ninth month the Bright Hall was worshipped and a general amnesty proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，美人謝氏進封貴妃。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Beautiful Person Lady Xie was advanced to Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Beautiful Person Lady Xie was advanced to Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳，熒惑、填星合於室。

translations.literal: On jisi of the tenth month in winter, Mars and Saturn conjoined in Shi.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the tenth month in winter Mars and Saturn conjoined in the mansion Shi.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，有星孛於天市垣。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the eleventh month, a broom star appeared in the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the eleventh month a broom star appeared in the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 丁未，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: On dingwei, a meteor fell by day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei a meteor fell by day.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，詔錄用孔子四十九代孫燦補官。

translations.literal: On gengshen of the twelfth month, an edict granted office to Confucius's forty-ninth-generation descendant Can.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the twelfth month an edict granted office to Confucius's forty-ninth-generation descendant Can.

sentences.zh: 李全叛。

translations.literal: Li Quan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Quan rebelled.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，淮東官兵王青力戰，死之，贈右武大夫、蘄州防禦使。

translations.literal: On renxu, Wang Qing of the Huaidong army fought fiercely and died; posthumously made Grand Master of the Right Martial Hall and Defender of Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Wang Qing of the Huaidong army fought fiercely and died; he was posthumously made Grand Master of the Right Martial Hall and Defender of Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔：「逆賊李全，反形日著，今乃肆爲不道，已敕江、淮制臣率兵進討，有能擒斬全以降者，加以不次之賞。

translations.literal: On jiazi, an edict: "The rebel Li Quan's treason has daily grown clearer; now he has committed outrage; We have ordered Jiang and Huai pacification commissioners to lead troops in pursuit; whoever can capture or kill Quan and surrender shall receive extraordinary reward.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi an edict declared: "The rebel Li Quan's treason has daily grown clearer; now he has committed outrage; We have ordered the Jiang and Huai pacification commissioners to lead troops in pursuit; whoever can capture or kill Quan and surrender shall receive extraordinary reward.

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，詔免明年元會禮。

translations.literal: On yichou, an edict exempted next year's New Year's court ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou an edict exempted next year's New Year's court ceremony.

sentences.zh: 以鄭清之參知政事兼簽書樞密院事，喬行簡端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Zheng Qingzhi was made Vice Commissioner of the Council and Commissioner of Military Affairs; Ji Xingjian Academician of the Bright Hall and Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Qingzhi was made Vice Commissioner of the Council and Commissioner of Military Affairs; Ji Xingjian Academician of the Bright Hall and Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔：「史彌遠敷奏精敏，氣體向安，朕未欲勞以朝謁，可十日一赴都堂治事。

translations.literal: An edict: "Shi Miyuan's memorials are precise and keen and his constitution tends toward ease; We do not yet wish to weary him with court attendance—he may come to the chief council hall once every ten days to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Shi Miyuan's memorials are precise and keen and his constitution tends toward ease; We do not yet wish to weary him with court attendance—he may come to the chief council hall once every ten days to conduct affairs.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，冊命貴妃謝氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Noble Consort Lady Xie was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Noble Consort Lady Xie was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 己卯，慈明殿出緡錢百五十萬犒諸軍，振贍在京細民。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Hall of Ciming disbursed 1,500,000 strings in cash to reward the armies and relieve the capital's poor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Hall of Ciming disbursed 1,500,000 strings in cash to reward the armies and relieve the capital's poor.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上壽明仁福慈睿皇太后尊號冊寶。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the honorific title and seal of Empress Dowager Shouming Renfu Cirui were presented.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the honorific title and seal for Empress Dowager Shouming Renfu Cirui were presented.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月戊子，皇太后年七十有五，上詣慈明殿行慶壽禮，大赦，史彌遠以下進秩有差。

translations.literal: On wuzi of the first month in spring in the fourth year, the Empress Dowager was seventy-five; the emperor went to the Hall of Ciming to perform birthday celebration rites; general amnesty; Shi Miyuan and others were advanced in rank with differences.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the first month in spring in the fourth year the Empress Dowager was seventy-five; the emperor went to the Hall of Ciming to perform birthday celebration rites; a general amnesty was proclaimed; Shi Miyuan and others were advanced in rank, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 賜李心傳同進士出身。

translations.literal: Li Xinchuan was granted ranked pass equal to jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xinchuan was granted ranked pass equal to jinshi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，趙范、趙葵等誅李全於新塘，詔各進兩秩，餘推恩有差。

translations.literal: On renyin, Zhao Fan, Zhao Kui, and others executed Li Quan at Xintang; an edict advanced each two ranks, with graded favors for the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhao Fan, Zhao Kui, and others executed Li Quan at Xintang; an edict advanced each two ranks, with graded favors for the others.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午朔，詔：雄邊軍統制、總轄范勝、穀汝礪等誅逆著勞，各官五轉，將士立功者，趣具等第、姓名來上。

translations.literal: On wuwu, first day of the second month, an edict: Frontier Army commander-in-chief and overseer Fan Sheng, Gu Ruli, and others who executed the rebel with manifest merit each advanced five ranks in office; soldiers who achieved merit should quickly submit graded lists of names.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the first day of the second month, an edict declared that Frontier Army commander-in-chief and overseer Fan Sheng, Gu Ruli, and others who executed the rebel with manifest merit each advanced five ranks in office, and that soldiers who achieved merit should quickly submit graded lists of names.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔起復孟珙從義郎、京西路分，棗陽軍駐紮。

translations.literal: On bingzi, an edict recalled Meng Gong to office as Gentleman for Following Righteousness on the Jingxi Circuit, garrisoned at Zaoyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict recalled Meng Gong to office as Gentleman for Following Righteousness on the Jingxi Circuit, garrisoned at Zaoyang Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，趙范、趙葵並進中大夫、右文殿修撰，賜紫章服、金帶。

translations.literal: On wuchen of the fourth month in summer, Zhao Fan and Zhao Kui were both advanced to Grand Master of Palace Provision and Academician for Cultivating Culture in the Right Literary Hall, bestowed purple robes and golden belt.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen of the fourth month in summer Zhao Fan and Zhao Kui were both advanced to Grand Master of Palace Provision and Academician for Cultivating Culture in the Right Literary Hall, and bestowed purple robes and a golden belt.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以鄭清之兼同知樞密院事；

translations.literal: On dingchou, Zheng Qingzhi was made concurrently Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Zheng Qingzhi was made concurrently Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs;

sentences.zh: 喬行簡簽書樞密院事；

translations.literal: Ji Xingjian Commissioner of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Ji Xingjian Commissioner of Military Affairs;

sentences.zh: 趙善湘兵部尚書、江淮制置大使、知建康府，依舊安撫使；

translations.literal: Zhao Shanxiang Minister of War, Huai-Jiang Pacification Grand Commissioner, and prefect of Jiankang, retaining his former post as pacification commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shanxiang Minister of War, Huai-Jiang Pacification Grand Commissioner, and prefect of Jiankang, retaining his former post as pacification commissioner;

sentences.zh: 趙范權兵部侍郎、淮東安撫副使、知揚州兼江淮制司參謀官；

translations.literal: Zhao Fan acting Vice Minister of War, Huaidong Deputy Pacification Commissioner, prefect of Yangzhou and staff officer of the Huai-Jiang Pacification Office;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Fan acting Vice Minister of War, Huaidong Deputy Pacification Commissioner, prefect of Yangzhou and staff officer of the Huai-Jiang Pacification Office;

sentences.zh: 趙葵換福州觀察使、右驍衛大將軍、淮東提刑、知滁州兼大使司參議官。

translations.literal: Zhao Kui transferred to Military Commissioner of Fuzhou, Grand General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard, Huaidong penal intendant, prefect of Chuzhou and deliberative officer of the grand commissioner's office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Kui was transferred to Military Commissioner of Fuzhou, Grand General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard, Huaidong penal intendant, prefect of Chuzhou and deliberative officer of the grand commissioner's office.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，宗室司正檢校少傅、安德軍節度使、天水郡公，加食邑五百戶；

translations.literal: On bingwu of the fifth month, the imperial clansman Director of the Clan Court, acting Junior Preceptor, Military Commissioner of Ande Army, Duke of Tianshui, was granted an additional 500 households in his fief;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu of the fifth month the imperial clansman Director of the Clan Court, acting Junior Preceptor, Military Commissioner of the Ande Army, and Duke of Tianshui, was granted an additional 500 households in his fief;

sentences.zh: 貴謙承宣使；

translations.literal: Guiqian Grand Commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Guiqian Grand Commissioner;

sentences.zh: 乃裕觀察使。

translations.literal: Naiyu Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Naiyu Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，詔魏了翁、真德秀、尤焴、尤爚并敘復元官職祠祿。

translations.literal: On jiwei of the sixth month, an edict restored Wei Liaoweng, Zhen Dexiu, You Huang, and You Shao to their former offices and sinecure stipends.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the sixth month an edict restored Wei Liaoweng, Zhen Dexiu, You Huang, and You Shao to their former offices and sinecure stipends.

sentences.zh: 七月己丑，日生承氣。

translations.literal: On jichou of the seventh month, the sun displayed a coronal aura.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the seventh month the sun displayed a coronal aura.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賈涉女侍後宮，詔封文安郡夫人。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Jia She's daughter attended the inner palace; an edict enfeoffed her Lady of Wen'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Jia She's daughter attended the inner palace; an edict enfeoffed her Lady of Wen'an.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，葛洪資政殿學士、知紹興府。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Ge Hong Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and prefect of Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Ge Hong was made Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and prefect of Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: A meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，大元兵破武休，入興元，攻仙人關。

translations.literal: On jiwei of the eighth month, Great Yuan troops broke Wuxiu, entered Xingyuan, and attacked Xianren Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the eighth month Great Yuan troops broke Wuxiu, entered Xingyuan, and attacked Xianren Pass.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，洪咨夔敘復元官祠祿。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Hong Zicui was restored to his former office and sinecure stipend.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Hong Zicui was restored to his former office and sinecure stipend.

sentences.zh: 辛未，文安郡夫人賈氏封才人。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Lady Jia of Wen'an was enfeoffed Talented Person.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Lady Jia of Wen'an was enfeoffed Talented Person.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌夜，臨安火，延及太廟，統制徐儀、統領馬振遠坐救焚不力，貶削有差。

translations.literal: On the night of bingxu of the ninth month, fire broke out in Lin'an and spread to the Imperial Temple; Commander Xu Yi and Commander Ma Zhenyuan were demoted with differences for failing to fight the blaze effectively.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of bingxu of the ninth month fire broke out in Lin'an and spread to the Imperial Temple; Commander Xu Yi and Commander Ma Zhenyuan were demoted with differences for failing to fight the blaze effectively.

sentences.zh: 上素服視朝，減膳徹樂。

translations.literal: The emperor attended court in plain dress, reduced his meals, and suspended music.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor attended court in plain dress, reduced his meals, and suspended music.

sentences.zh: 庚子，建昌軍火。

translations.literal: On gengzi, fire in Jianchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Jianchang Army suffered a fire.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，流星晝隕。

translations.literal: On jiachen, a meteor fell by day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen a meteor fell by day.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，太常少卿度正、國史院編修官李心傳各疏言：宗廟之制，未合于古，茲緣災異，宜舉行之。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the tenth month in winter, Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices Du Zheng and Compiler of the National History Li Xinchuan each memorialized: the ancestral temple system did not accord with antiquity; now because of this disaster and portent it should be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the tenth month in winter Vice Director of Imperial Sacrifices Du Zheng and Compiler of the National History Li Xinchuan each memorialized that the ancestral temple system did not accord with antiquity and that, in view of this disaster and portent, it should now be implemented.

sentences.zh: 詔兩省、侍從、台諫集議以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered both provincial bureaus, attendants-in-waiting, and remonstrators and censors to deliberate collectively and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered both provincial bureaus, attendants-in-waiting, and remonstrators and censors to deliberate collectively and report.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以餘天錫爲戶部侍郎兼知臨安府、浙西安撫使。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Yu Tianxi was made Vice Minister of Revenue and concurrently prefect of Lin'an and Zhexi Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Yu Tianxi was made Vice Minister of Revenue and concurrently prefect of Lin'an and Zhexi Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大元兵破蜀口諸郡，御前中軍統制張宣戰青野原有功，詔授沔州都統。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Great Yuan troops broke the prefectures at the Shu passes; Commander of the Imperial Middle Army Zhang Xuan fought at Qingye Plain with merit; an edict appointed him Commander of Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Great Yuan troops broke the prefectures at the Shu passes; Commander of the Imperial Middle Army Zhang Xuan fought at Qingye Plain with merit; an edict appointed him Commander of Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以李𡌴爲煥章閣直學士、四川制置使、知成都府，趙彥呐直龍圖閣、四川安撫制置副使、知興元府、利路安撫使，安癸仲戶部郎中、總領四川財賦。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Li Kun was made Direct Academician of the Huanzhang Hall, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Chengdu; Zhao Yan'na Direct Academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall, Sichuan Deputy Pacification and Pacification Commissioner, prefect of Xingyuan and Lizhou Pacification Commissioner; An Guizhong Director of the Revenue Bureau, chief commissioner of Sichuan finances.
