translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Kun was made Direct Academician of the Huanzhang Hall, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Chengdu; Zhao Yan'na Direct Academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall, Sichuan Deputy Pacification and Pacification Commissioner, prefect of Xingyuan and Lizhou Pacification Commissioner; and An Guizhong Director of the Revenue Bureau and chief commissioner of Sichuan finances.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，詔忠義總管田遂力戰而歿，贈武節大夫、忠州刺史，加封立廟。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the eleventh month, an edict: Loyalist commander Tian Sui fought fiercely and died; posthumously made Grand Master of Martial Integrity and Military Commissioner of Zhongzhou; additionally ordered a temple erected.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the eleventh month an edict declared that Loyalist commander Tian Sui fought fiercely and died; he was posthumously made Grand Master of Martial Integrity and Military Commissioner of Zhongzhou, and a temple was additionally ordered erected.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，以史嵩之爲大理少卿兼京湖制置副使。

translations.literal: On yihai of the twelfth month, Shi Songzhi was made Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review and concurrently Deputy Pacification Commissioner of Jing-Hu.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the twelfth month Shi Songzhi was made Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review and concurrently Deputy Pacification Commissioner of Jing-Hu.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己丑，以孟珙爲京西路兵馬鈐轄、棗陽軍駐紮。

translations.literal: On jichou of the first month in spring in the fifth year, Meng Gong was made Overseer of Jingxi Circuit forces and garrisoned at Zaoyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the first month in spring in the fifth year Meng Gong was made Overseer of Jingxi Circuit forces and garrisoned at Zaoyang Army.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔：李全之叛，淮東提刑司檢法吳澄等出泰州城謁賊，各追官勒停。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict: because of Li Quan's rebellion, Wu Cheng and others of the Huaidong penal commission's legal staff went out of Taizhou city to pay respects to the bandit—each was stripped of office and forbidden service.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin an edict declared that because of Li Quan's rebellion, Wu Cheng and others of the Huaidong penal commission's legal staff went out of Taizhou city to pay respects to the bandit—each was stripped of office and forbidden further service.

sentences.zh: 其不出見賊者高夢月、劉賓雲循升二資。

translations.literal: Those who did not go out to see the bandit—Gao Mengyue and Liu Binyun—were advanced two grades in qualification.
translations.idiomatic: Those who did not go out to see the bandit—Gao Mengyue and Liu Binyun—were advanced two grades in qualification.

sentences.zh: 罵賊而死者海陵簿吳嚞，特贈朝奉郎，官其一子將仕郎。

translations.literal: Wu Xi, registrar of Hailing who cursed the bandit and died, was specially posthumously made Gentleman for Court Audience and one son granted Gentleman for Service.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xi, registrar of Hailing who cursed the bandit and died, was specially posthumously made Gentleman for Court Audience and one son was granted Gentleman for Service.

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，史嵩之進大理卿、權刑部侍郎、京湖安撫制置使、知襄陽府。

translations.literal: On renchen, Shi Songzhi was advanced Vice Director of Judicial Review, acting Vice Minister of Punishments, Jing-Hu Pacification and Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Shi Songzhi was advanced Vice Director of Judicial Review, acting Vice Minister of Punishments, Jing-Hu Pacification and Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，新作太廟成。

translations.literal: On renyin, the newly built Imperial Temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the newly built Imperial Temple was completed.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，帝謁太廟。

translations.literal: On guichou of the second month, the emperor visited the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the second month the emperor visited the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，詔京城內外免征商三月。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the third month, an edict exempted commercial taxes inside and outside the capital for three months.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the third month an edict exempted commercial taxes inside and outside the capital for three months.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，日後抱氣、承氣。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the sun displayed halos behind and before it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the sun displayed halos behind and before it.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，以寶章閣直學士桂如淵頃帥蜀日，北兵攻城，不能合謀死守而遁，致軍民罹殃，反以捷聞，詔褫職罷祠。

translations.literal: On guihai of the fourth month in summer, because when Direct Academician of the Baozhang Hall Gui Ruyuan lately commanded Shu, when northern troops besieged a city he could not unite in planning a loyal defense and fled, causing army and people to suffer calamity, yet reported victory—an edict stripped office and dismissed his sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai of the fourth month in summer, because when Direct Academician of the Baozhang Hall Gui Ruyuan had lately commanded Shu, when northern troops besieged a city he could not unite in planning a loyal defense and fled, causing army and people to suffer calamity, yet reported victory—an edict stripped his office and dismissed his sinecure.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，起魏了翁以集英殿修撰知遂寧府。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Wei Liaoweng was recalled as Academician for Assembling Excellence and prefect of Suining.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Wei Liaoweng was recalled as Academician for Assembling Excellence and prefect of Suining.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，詔：「昨鬱攸爲災，延及太室，罪在朕躬，而二三執政，引咎去職。

translations.literal: On jichou of the fifth month, an edict: "Yesterday raging fire was a disaster extending to the Grand Chamber—the guilt lies on Our person, yet two or three chief ministers took blame and left office.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the fifth month an edict declared: "Yesterday raging fire was a disaster extending to the Grand Chamber—the guilt lies on Our person, yet two or three chief ministers took blame and left office.

sentences.zh: 今宗廟崇成，神御妥安，薛極、鄭清之、喬行簡並復元官。

translations.literal: Now the ancestral temple is majestically completed and the imperial spirits rest in peace—Xue Ji, Zheng Qingzhi, and Ji Xingjian are all restored to their former offices.
translations.idiomatic: Now the ancestral temple is majestically completed and the imperial spirits rest in peace—Xue Ji, Zheng Qingzhi, and Ji Xingjian are all restored to their former offices.

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，臣僚言：「積陰霖霪，曆夏徂秋，疑必有致咎之征。

translations.literal: On xinmao, officials memorialized: "Prolonged yin and unceasing rain from summer into autumn—We suspect there must be signs inviting calamity.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao officials memorialized: "Prolonged yin and unceasing rain from summer into autumn—We suspect there must be signs inviting calamity.

sentences.zh: 比聞蘄州進士馮傑，本儒家，都大坑冶司抑爲爐戶，誅求日增，傑妻以憂死，其女繼之，弟大聲因赴訴，死于道路，傑知不免，毒其二子一妾，舉火自經而死。

translations.literal: We have heard that jinshi Feng Jie of Qizhou, originally of the Ru school, was pressed by the Chief Smelting Office into service as a furnace household with daily increasing exactions—Jie's wife died of grief, his daughter followed, his younger brother Dasheng died on the road while going to appeal, Jie knowing he could not escape poisoned his two sons and one concubine and burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: We have heard that jinshi Feng Jie of Qizhou, originally of the Ru school, was pressed by the Chief Smelting Office into service as a furnace household with daily increasing exactions—Jie's wife died of grief, his daughter followed, his younger brother Dasheng died on the road while going to appeal, and Jie, knowing he could not escape, poisoned his two sons and one concubine and burned himself to death.

sentences.zh: 民冤至此，豈不上幹陰陽之和？

translations.literal: When popular wrong reaches this point, does it not ascend to disturb the harmony of yin and yang?"
translations.idiomatic: When popular wrong reaches this point, does it not ascend to disturb the harmony of yin and yang?"

sentences.zh: 」詔都大坑冶魏峴罷職。

translations.literal: An edict dismissed Chief Smelter Wei Xian from office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dismissed Chief Smelter Wei Xian from office.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太白經天，晝見。

translations.literal: On guisi, the Great White Star crossed the sky and was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Great White Star crossed the sky and was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔今後齊民有罪，監司、守臣毋輒籍沒其家，必具聞俟命。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict: hereafter when common people commit crimes, surveillance commissioners and prefects must not rashly confiscate their households—they must report in detail and await command.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict declared that hereafter when common people commit crimes, surveillance commissioners and prefects must not rashly confiscate their households—they must report in detail and await command.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，熒惑、填星合于婁，熒惑順行犯填星。

translations.literal: On yichou of the sixth month, Mars and Saturn conjoined in Lou; Mars moved in direct motion and encroached on Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the sixth month Mars and Saturn conjoined in the mansion Lou; Mars moved in direct motion and encroached on Saturn.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔諸獄官不理他務。

translations.literal: On bingzi, an edict ordered all jail officials not to manage other affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict ordered all jail officials not to manage other affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，詔：「近歲北兵再入利、閬，迫近順慶，承奉郎胡元琰攝郡事，能收散卒，定居民，諭叛將，以全闔郡，以功特轉官三資。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the seventh month in autumn, an edict: "In recent years northern troops twice entered Li and Lang, pressing close to Shunqing; Attendant Gentleman Hu Yuanyan, acting prefect, was able to gather scattered troops, settle residents, persuade rebel generals, and preserve the whole prefecture—for merit specially advanced three grades in office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the seventh month in autumn an edict declared: "In recent years northern troops twice entered Li and Lang, pressing close to Shunqing; Attendant Gentleman Hu Yuanyan, acting prefect, was able to gather scattered troops, settle residents, persuade rebel generals, and preserve the whole prefecture—for merit he was specially advanced three grades in office.

sentences.zh: 」太白入井。

translations.literal: The Great White Star entered Jing.
translations.idiomatic: The Great White Star entered the mansion Jing.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，監楚州大軍倉富起宗軍變死難，詔贈宣教郎，官一子文林郎。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Supervisor of the Chuzhou Grand Army Granary Fu Qizong died in a military mutiny; an edict posthumously made him Gentleman for Promoting Culture and granted one son Gentleman for Literature.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Supervisor of the Chuzhou Grand Army Granary Fu Qizong died in a military mutiny; an edict posthumously made him Gentleman for Promoting Culture and granted one son Gentleman for Literature.

sentences.zh: 張煥同時被創，害及其家，詔轉官一資。

translations.literal: Zhang Huan was wounded at the same time and harm reached his family; an edict advanced one grade in office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Huan was wounded at the same time and harm reached his family; an edict advanced him one grade in office.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以吳潛爲太府少卿、總領淮西財賦，陳貴誼端明殿學士、同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Wu Qian was made Vice Director of the Palace Treasury and chief commissioner of Huaidong finances; Chen Guiyi Academician of the Bright Hall and Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Wu Qian was made Vice Director of the Palace Treasury and chief commissioner of Huaidong finances; Chen Guiyi Academician of the Bright Hall and Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，起真德秀爲徽猷閣待制、知泉州。

translations.literal: On yimao of the eighth month, Zhen Dexiu was recalled as Gentleman-in-waiting of the Huixuan Hall and prefect of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the eighth month Zhen Dexiu was recalled as Gentleman-in-waiting of the Huixuan Hall and prefect of Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，泗州路分劉虎、副都統董琳焚斷盱泗橋遏金兵。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Sizhou route commander Liu Hu and deputy commander Dong Lin burned and cut the Xusi bridge to block Jin troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Sizhou route commander Liu Hu and deputy commander Dong Lin burned and cut the Xusi bridge to block Jin troops.

sentences.zh: 己未，魏了翁以寶章閣待制、潼川安撫使知瀘州。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Wei Liaoweng was made Gentleman-in-waiting of the Baozhang Hall, Tongchuan Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Wei Liaoweng was made Gentleman-in-waiting of the Baozhang Hall, Tongchuan Pacification Commissioner, and prefect of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜進士徐元傑等四百九十三人及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On yichou, jinshi degrees and ranked passes were bestowed on Xu Yuanjie and 492 others with differences in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou jinshi degrees and ranked passes were granted to Xu Yuanjie and 492 others, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太白、歲星合于張。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Great White Star and Jupiter conjoined in Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Great White Star and Jupiter conjoined in the mansion Zhang.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，新作玉牒殿，奉安累朝玉牒。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the newly built Hall of Imperial Genealogies was completed and successive dynasties' genealogical registers were installed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the newly built Hall of Imperial Genealogies was completed and successive dynasties' genealogical registers were installed.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，雨雹，雷。

translations.literal: On yisi of the ninth month, hail and thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the ninth month there was hail and thunder.

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: On jiyou of the intercalary month, a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the intercalary month a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，彗星出於角。

translations.literal: On gengxu, a comet appeared in Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu a comet appeared in the mansion Jiao.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，史彌遠乞歸田裏，詔不允。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Shi Miyuan requested to return to his rural estate; an edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Shi Miyuan asked to retire to his rural estate; an edict did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，以星變，大赦。

translations.literal: On wuzi of the tenth month in winter, because of stellar changes, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the tenth month in winter, because of stellar changes, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 金將以盱眙軍來降，赦盱眙，改爲招信軍。

translations.literal: A Jin general came to surrender with the Xuyi army; Xuyi was pardoned and changed to Zhaoxin Army.
translations.idiomatic: A Jin general came to surrender with the Xuyi army; Xuyi was pardoned and renamed Zhaoxin Army.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，喬行簡累疏乞歸田，詔不允。

translations.literal: On jisi of the eleventh month, Ji Xingjian repeatedly memorialized begging to return to his rural estate; an edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the eleventh month Ji Xingjian repeatedly memorialized begging to retire to his rural estate; an edict did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子朔，進封才人賈氏爲貴妃。

translations.literal: On bingzi, first day of the twelfth month, Talented Person Lady Jia was advanced to Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the first day of the twelfth month, Talented Person Lady Jia was advanced to Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，皇太后不豫。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Empress Dowager fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the Empress Dowager fell ill.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大赦。

translations.literal: On renwu, general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 皇太后崩。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，群臣凡七表請聽政，從之。

translations.literal: On guimao, the officials in all seven memorials requested that the emperor hear government; he consented.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the officials in all seven memorials requested that the emperor hear government; he consented.

sentences.zh: 詔：外朝大典，不敢輕改，宮中自服三年喪。

translations.literal: An edict: great court ceremonies of the outer court dare not be lightly changed; within the palace the three-year mourning rites were observed on its own.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that great court ceremonies of the outer court dare not be lightly changed; within the palace the three-year mourning rites were observed on its own.

sentences.zh: 時宋與大元兵合圍汴京，金主奔歸德府，尋奔蔡州，大元再遣使議攻金，史嵩之以鄒伸之報謝。

translations.literal: At that time Song and Great Yuan troops jointly besieged Bianjing; the Jin ruler fled to Guide Prefecture and soon to Caizhou; Great Yuan again sent envoys to discuss attacking Jin; Shi Songzhi had Zou Shenzhi return thanks.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Song and Great Yuan troops jointly besieged Bianjing; the Jin ruler fled to Guide Prefecture and soon to Caizhou; Great Yuan again sent envoys to discuss attacking Jin; Shi Songzhi had Zou Shenzhi return thanks.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月己酉，以少傅、保寧軍節度使、嗣秀王師彌判大宗正事，趙善湘光祿大夫、江淮制置大使兼知建康府、行宮留守，加食邑四百戶。

translations.literal: On jiyou of the first month in spring in the sixth year, Junior Preceptor, Military Commissioner of Baoning Army, Heir to the Prince of Xiushi Shi Mi was made Administrator of the Imperial Clan Court; Zhao Shanxiang Grand Master of Palace Provision, Huai-Jiang Pacification Grand Commissioner and concurrently prefect of Jiankang and Palace Custodian, granted an additional 400 households in his fief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the first month in spring in the sixth year Junior Preceptor, Military Commissioner of the Baoning Army, and Heir to the Prince of Xiushi Shi Mi was made Administrator of the Imperial Clan Court; Zhao Shanxiang Grand Master of Palace Provision, Huai-Jiang Pacification Grand Commissioner and concurrently prefect of Jiankang and Palace Custodian, with an additional 400 households in his fief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，史彌遠加食邑千戶。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Shi Miyuan was granted an additional 1,000 households in his fief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Shi Miyuan was granted an additional 1,000 households in his fief.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，上大行皇太后諡曰恭聖仁烈皇后。

translations.literal: On dingchou of the second month, the posthumous title of the late Empress Dowager was presented: Gong, Sheng, Ren, Lie.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the second month the posthumous title of the late Empress Dowager was presented: Gong, Sheng, Ren, Lie.

sentences.zh: 以趙范爲工部侍郎兼中書門下省檢正公事，趙葵秘書監兼侍講，餘天錫禮部侍郎兼侍讀。

translations.literal: Zhao Fan was made Vice Minister of Works and concurrently Inspector-General of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Zhao Kui Director of the Secretariat and concurrent lecturer-in-waiting; Yu Tianxi Vice Minister of Rites and concurrent reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Fan was made Vice Minister of Works and concurrently Inspector-General of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Zhao Kui Director of the Secretariat and concurrent lecturer-in-waiting; Yu Tianxi Vice Minister of Rites and concurrent reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，熒惑犯東井。

translations.literal: On guimao, Mars encroached on the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Mars encroached on the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，大雨、雹。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the third month, great rain and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the third month there was great rain and hail.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，葬恭聖烈皇后于永茂陵。

translations.literal: On renyin of the fourth month in summer, the late Empress Gong Sheng Lie was buried at Yongmao Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the fourth month in summer the late Empress Gong Sheng Lie was buried at Yongmao Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，太白、熒惑合于柳。

translations.literal: On gengxu of the fifth month, the Great White Star and Mars conjoined in Liu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the fifth month the Great White Star and Mars conjoined in the mansion Liu.

sentences.zh: 鄧州移剌以城來降。

translations.literal: Yelü Yi of Dengzhou surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Yi of Dengzhou surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，史嵩之刑部侍郎兼京湖安撫制置使兼知襄陽府。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the sixth month, Shi Songzhi Vice Minister of Punishments and concurrently Jing-Hu Pacification and Pacification Commissioner and prefect of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the sixth month Shi Songzhi was made Vice Minister of Punishments and concurrently Jing-Hu Pacification and Pacification Commissioner and prefect of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，敗武仙於浙江。

translations.literal: In the seventh month in autumn, Wu Xian was defeated on the Zhe River.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month in autumn Wu Xian was defeated on the Zhe River.

sentences.zh: 八月，拔唐州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Tangzhou was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Tangzhou was captured.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On renyin, first day of the ninth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the first day of the ninth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Bright Hall was worshipped; general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Bright Hall was worshipped and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，經筵官請以御制敬天、法祖、事親、齊家四十八條及緝熙殿榜、《殿記》宣付史館。

translations.literal: On xinyou, classics-colloquium officials requested that the emperor's compositions "Revering Heaven," "Honoring Ancestors," "Serving Parents," and "Ordering the Household" in forty-eight articles, together with the Jixi Hall placard and Hall Record, be forwarded to the Historiographical Office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou classics-colloquium officials requested that the emperor's compositions "Revering Heaven," "Honoring Ancestors," "Serving Parents," and "Ordering the Household" in forty-eight articles, together with the Jixi Hall placard and Hall Record, be forwarded to the Historiographical Office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，江海領襄軍從大元兵合圍金主于蔡州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month in winter, Jiang Hai led Xiang troops to join Great Yuan forces in besieging the Jin ruler at Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month in winter Jiang Hai led Xiang troops to join Great Yuan forces in besieging the Jin ruler at Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，史宅之太府少卿，史宇之將作少監，並賜同進士出身。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Shi Zhaizhi Vice Director of the Palace Treasury and Shi Yuzhi Vice Director of Palace Construction were both granted ranked pass equal to jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Shi Zhaizhi Vice Director of the Palace Treasury and Shi Yuzhi Vice Director of Palace Construction were both granted ranked pass equal to jinshi.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，史彌遠進太師、左丞相兼樞密使、魯國公，加食邑一千戶；

translations.literal: On bingxu, Shi Miyuan was advanced Grand Preceptor, Left Chancellor and Commissioner of Military Affairs, Duke of Lu, with an additional 1,000 households in his fief;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Shi Miyuan was advanced Grand Preceptor, Left Chancellor and Commissioner of Military Affairs, Duke of Lu, with an additional 1,000 households in his fief;

sentences.zh: 鄭清之光祿大夫、右丞相兼樞密使，加食邑一千戶。

translations.literal: Zheng Qingzhi Grand Master of Palace Provision, Right Chancellor and Commissioner of Military Affairs, with an additional 1,000 households in his fief.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Qingzhi Grand Master of Palace Provision, Right Chancellor and Commissioner of Military Affairs, with an additional 1,000 households in his fief.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，史彌遠保寧、昭信軍節度使，充醴泉觀使，進封會稽郡王，仍奉朝請，加食邑封。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Shi Miyuan Military Commissioner of Baoning and Zhaoxin Armies, Superintendent of the Liquan Abbey, advanced to Prince of Kuaiji, still attending court, with additional fief households.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Shi Miyuan Military Commissioner of the Baoning and Zhaoxin Armies, Superintendent of the Liquan Abbey, advanced to Prince of Kuaiji, still attending court, with additional fief households.

sentences.zh: 以薛極爲樞密使，喬行簡參知政事兼同知樞密院事，陳貴誼參知政事兼簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Xue Ji was made Commissioner of Military Affairs; Ji Xingjian Vice Commissioner of the Council and Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs; Chen Guiyi Vice Commissioner of the Council and Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ji was made Commissioner of Military Affairs; Ji Xingjian Vice Commissioner of the Council and Associate Commissioner of Military Affairs; Chen Guiyi Vice Commissioner of the Council and Commissioner of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔：「史彌遠有定策大功，勤勞王室，今以疾解政，宜加優禮。

translations.literal: An edict: "Shi Miyuan has great merit in settling the succession and has labored diligently for the royal house; now because of illness he relinquishes government—he should receive exceptional honors.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Shi Miyuan has great merit in settling the succession and has labored diligently for the royal house; now because of illness he relinquishes government—he should receive exceptional honors.

sentences.zh: 長子宅之權戶部侍郎兼崇政殿說書，次子宇之直華文閣、樞密院副都承旨，長孫同卿直寶章閣，次孫紹卿、良卿、會卿、晉卿並承事郎，女夫趙汝禖軍器少監，孫女夫趙崇榟官一轉。

translations.literal: The eldest son Zhaizhi acting Vice Minister of Revenue and lecturer at the Hall for Cherishing Governance; the second son Yuzhi Direct Academician of the Huawen Hall and Deputy Chief Usher of the Bureau of Military Affairs; the eldest grandson Tongqing Direct Academician of the Baozhang Hall; the grandsons Shaoqing, Liangqing, Huiqing, and Jinqing all Gentlemen for Service; sons-in-law Zhao Rushen Superintendent of Armaments and Zhao Chongrong advanced one rank in office.
translations.idiomatic: The eldest son Zhaizhi was made acting Vice Minister of Revenue and lecturer at the Hall for Cherishing Governance; the second son Yuzhi Direct Academician of the Huawen Hall and Deputy Chief Usher of the Bureau of Military Affairs; the eldest grandson Tongqing Direct Academician of the Baozhang Hall; the grandsons Shaoqing, Liangqing, Huiqing, and Jinqing all Gentlemen for Service; son-in-law Zhao Rushen Superintendent of Armaments and granddaughter's husband Zhao Chongrong each advanced one rank in office.

sentences.zh: 」己丑，詔崔與之、李𡌴、鄭性之赴闕。

translations.literal: On jichou, an edict summoned Cui Yuzhi, Li Kun, and Zheng Xingzhi to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict summoned Cui Yuzhi, Li Kun, and Zheng Xingzhi to court.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以顯謨閣待制、知福州真德秀兼福建安撫使。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Zhen Dexiu Gentleman-in-waiting of the Xianmo Hall and prefect of Fuzhou was made concurrently Fujian Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Zhen Dexiu, Gentleman-in-waiting of the Xianmo Hall and prefect of Fuzhou, was made concurrently Fujian Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙未，史彌遠薨，贈中書令，追封衛王，諡忠獻。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Shi Miyuan died; posthumously made Vice Director of the Secretariat and enfeoffed Prince of Wei, posthumous name Zhongxian.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Shi Miyuan died; he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Secretariat and enfeoffed Prince of Wei, with posthumous name Zhongxian.

sentences.zh: 詔戒貪吏。

translations.literal: An edict warned against grasping officials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict warned against grasping officials.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，給事中莫澤等言，差提舉千秋鴻禧觀梁成大暴狠貪婪，苟賤無恥，詔奪成大祠祿。

translations.literal: On yisi of the eleventh month, Supervising Draftsman Mo Ze and others said that the assigned Superintendent of the Qianqiu Hongxi Abbey Liang Chengda was violent, greedy, shameless, and base; an edict stripped Chengda of his sinecure stipend.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the eleventh month Supervising Draftsman Mo Ze and others charged that the assigned Superintendent of the Qianqiu Hongxi Abbey Liang Chengda was violent, greedy, shameless, and base; an edict stripped Chengda of his sinecure stipend.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔改明年爲端平元年。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict changed the next year to the first year of Duanping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu an edict changed the next year to the first year of Duanping.

sentences.zh: 己未，以魏了翁爲華文閣待制、知瀘州、潼川安撫使，賜金帶。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Wei Liaoweng was made Gentleman-in-waiting of the Huawen Hall, prefect of Luzhou and Tongchuan Pacification Commissioner, and bestowed a golden belt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Wei Liaoweng was made Gentleman-in-waiting of the Huawen Hall, prefect of Luzhou and Tongchuan Pacification Commissioner, and bestowed a golden belt.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，進趙葵兵部侍郎、淮東制置使兼知揚州。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zhao Kui was advanced Vice Minister of War and Huaidong Pacification Commissioner and concurrently prefect of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhao Kui was advanced Vice Minister of War and Huaidong Pacification Commissioner and concurrently prefect of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，台臣劾刑部尚書莫澤貪淫忮害，罷之。

translations.literal: On jiazi, censorate officials impeached Minister of Punishments Mo Ze for greed, licentiousness, jealousy, and harm; he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi censorate officials impeached Minister of Punishments Mo Ze for greed, licentiousness, jealousy, and harm; he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，權工部尚書趙范言：「宣和海上之盟，厥初甚美，迄以取禍，其事不可不鑒。

translations.literal: On bingyin, acting Minister of Works Zhao Fan said: "The alliance on the sea in the Xuanhe period was at first very fine but ended in bringing calamity—this matter must not fail to serve as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin acting Minister of Works Zhao Fan said: "The alliance on the sea in the Xuanhe period was at first very fine but ended in bringing calamity—this matter must not fail to serve as a warning.

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and adopted his counsel.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔趙葵任責防禦。

translations.literal: On dingmao, an edict charged Zhao Kui with responsibility for defense.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao an edict charged Zhao Kui with responsibility for defense.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，禮部郎中洪咨夔進對：今日急務，進君子，退小人，如真德秀、魏了翁當聚之於朝。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Director of the Rites Bureau Hong Zicui entered audience: today's urgent task is to advance gentlemen and dismiss petty men—men like Zhen Dexiu and Wei Liaoweng should be gathered at court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Director of the Rites Bureau Hong Zicui entered audience and said today's urgent task was to advance gentlemen and dismiss petty men—men like Zhen Dexiu and Wei Liaoweng should be gathered at court.

sentences.zh: 帝是其言，命咨夔洎王遂同爲監察御史。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words and ordered Zicui together with Wang Sui to serve as supervising censors.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his words and ordered Zicui together with Wang Sui to serve as supervising censors.

sentences.zh: 己巳，趙葵入見，帝問以金事，對曰：「今國家兵力未贍，姑從和議。

translations.literal: On jisi, Zhao Kui entered audience; the emperor asked about Jin affairs; he replied: "Now the state's military strength is not yet sufficient—for the moment follow the peace agreement.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhao Kui entered audience; the emperor asked about Jin affairs; he replied, "Now the state's military strength is not yet sufficient—for the moment follow the peace agreement.

sentences.zh: 俟根本既壯，雪二帝之恥，以復中原。

translations.literal: Wait until the foundation is strong, then avenge the shame of the two emperors and recover the Central Plain.
translations.idiomatic: Wait until the foundation is strong, then avenge the shame of the two emperors and recover the Central Plain.

sentences.zh: 」十二月戊寅，史宅之繳納賜第，詔給賜本家，仍奉家廟。

translations.literal: On wuyin of the twelfth month, Shi Zhaizhi returned the bestowed mansion; an edict granted it to his own family and still maintained the family temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the twelfth month Shi Zhaizhi returned the bestowed mansion; an edict granted it to his own family and still maintained the family temple.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以薛極爲觀文殿大學士、知紹興府兼浙東安撫使。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Xue Ji was made Grand Master of the Hall for Observing Culture and prefect of Shaoxing and concurrently Zhedong Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Xue Ji was made Grand Master of the Hall for Observing Culture and prefect of Shaoxing and concurrently Zhedong Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，吳潛太府卿，仍淮西總領財賦，暫兼沿江制置、知建康府。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Wu Qian Director of the Palace Treasury, still chief commissioner of Huaidong finances, temporarily concurrently River-Coast Pacification Commissioner and prefect of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Wu Qian was made Director of the Palace Treasury, still chief commissioner of Huaidong finances, and temporarily concurrently River-Coast Pacification Commissioner and prefect of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，洪咨夔言：「資政殿學士、提舉洞霄宮袁韶，仇視善類，諂附彌遠，險忮傾危。

translations.literal: On wushen, Hong Zicui said: "Grand Master of the Hall for Assisting Governance, Superintendent of the Dongxiao Abbey Yuan Shao, hates the good, fawns on Miyuan, is treacherous and jealous and overturns stability.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Hong Zicui said: "Grand Master of the Hall for Assisting Governance and Superintendent of the Dongxiao Abbey Yuan Shao hates the good, fawned on Miyuan, and is treacherous, jealous, and overturns stability.

sentences.zh: 」詔袁韶奪職、罷祠祿。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Yuan Shao of office and dismissed his sinecure stipend.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Yuan Shao of office and dismissed his sinecure stipend.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，台臣言：「趙善湘、陳晐、鄭損納賂彌遠，怙勢肆奸，失江淮、荊襄、蜀漢人心，罪狀顯著。

translations.literal: On renchen, censorate officials said: "Zhao Shanxiang, Chen Gai, and Zheng Sun bribed Miyuan, relied on power to commit wickedness, and lost the hearts of people in Jiang-Huai, Jing-Xiang, and Shu-Han—the crimes are manifest.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen censorate officials said: "Zhao Shanxiang, Chen Gai, and Zheng Sun bribed Miyuan, relied on power to commit wickedness, and lost the hearts of people in Jiang-Huai, Jing-Xiang, and Shu-Han—the crimes are manifest.

sentences.zh: 」詔趙善湘有討李全功，特寢免；

translations.literal: An edict: because Zhao Shanxiang had merit in punishing Li Quan, the case was specially set aside;
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that because Zhao Shanxiang had merit in punishing Li Quan, the case was specially set aside;

sentences.zh: 陳晐與祠，鄭損落職與祠。

translations.literal: Chen Gai was given a sinecure; Zheng Sun was stripped of office and given a sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Gai was given a sinecure; Zheng Sun was stripped of office and given a sinecure.

sentences.zh: 端平元年春正月庚子朔，詔求直言。

translations.literal: On gengzi, first day of the first month in spring in the first year of Duanping, an edict sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the first day of the first month in spring in the first year of Duanping, an edict sought blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 侍從、卿監、郎官，在外執政、從官，舉堪爲監司、守令者各二人。

translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the sun displayed a crimson halo.

translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the moon entered the mansion Di.

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Palace Army to select a thousand elite troops; Commander Lou Gong and Commander Yang Xin were ordered to pursue and capture the Jianyang bandits.

sentences.zh: 幸巳，詔故端明殿學士、開府儀同三司史彌遠贈資政殿大學士，諡忠宣。

translations.literal: On xinsi, an edict posthumously granted the late Academician of the Bright Hall and Grand Preceptor with ceremonial equal to the Three Excellencies Shi Miyuan the title Grand Master of the Hall for Assisting Governance, posthumous name Zhongxuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict posthumously granted the late Academician of the Bright Hall and Grand Preceptor with honors equal to the Three Excellencies Shi Miyuan the title Grand Master of the Hall for Assisting Governance, with posthumous name Zhongxuan.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯填星。

translations.literal: Mars encroached on Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroached on Saturn.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: On bingxu, a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.

sentences.zh: 戊子，日暈不匝，生格氣。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the sun's halo did not complete the circuit and displayed lattice vapor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the sun's halo did not complete the circuit and displayed lattice vapor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，史嵩之進兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On guisi, Shi Songzhi was advanced Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Shi Songzhi was advanced Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 禁毀銅錢作器用並貿易下海。

translations.literal: Destruction of copper cash for utensils and trade going to sea was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Destruction of copper cash for utensils and trade going to sea was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，詔嘉興縣王臨年百二歲，補迪功郎致仕。

translations.literal: On yisi of the seventh month in autumn, an edict: because Wang Lin of Jiaxing County was one hundred two years old, he was appointed Di Gong Gentleman and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the seventh month in autumn an edict declared that because Wang Lin of Jiaxing County was one hundred two years old, he was appointed Di Gong Gentleman and retired.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，詔：「河南新復郡縣，久廢播種，民甚艱食，江、淮制司其發米麥百萬石往濟歸附軍民，仍榜諭開封、應天、河南三京。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the eighth month, an edict: "The newly recovered prefectures and counties in Henan have long ceased sowing and the people suffer extreme food hardship—the Jiang and Huai pacification offices should dispatch a million piculs of grain and wheat to relieve returning soldiers and civilians, and still post notices at the three capitals of Kaifeng, Yingtian, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the eighth month an edict declared: "The newly recovered prefectures and counties in Henan have long ceased sowing and the people suffer extreme food hardship—the Jiang and Huai pacification offices should dispatch a million piculs of grain and wheat to relieve returning soldiers and civilians, and still post notices at the three capitals of Kaifeng, Yingtian, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，朱揚祖、林拓朝謁八陵回，以圖進，上問諸陵相去幾何及陵前澗水新復，揚祖悉以對，上忍涕太息。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Zhu Yangzu and Lin Tuo returned from paying respects at the Eight Mausoleums and presented maps; the emperor asked how far the mausoleums were from one another and whether the streams before the tombs had been newly restored—Yangzu answered fully; the emperor held back tears and sighed deeply.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Zhu Yangzu and Lin Tuo returned from paying respects at the Eight Mausoleums and presented maps; the emperor asked how far the mausoleums were from one another and whether the streams before the tombs had been newly restored—Yangzu answered fully; the emperor held back tears and sighed deeply.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以趙範爲京河關陝宣撫使、知開封府、東京留守，趙葵京河制置使、知應天府、南京留守，全子才關陝制置使、知河南府、西京留守。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Zhao Fan was made Pacification Commissioner of Jing-He, Guan, and Shaan, prefect of Kaifeng and Custodian of the Eastern Capital; Zhao Kui Jing-He Pacification Commissioner, prefect of Yingtian and Custodian of the Southern Capital; Quan Zicai Guan-Shaan Pacification Commissioner, prefect of Henan and Custodian of the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhao Fan was made Pacification Commissioner of Jing-He, Guan, and Shaan, prefect of Kaifeng and Custodian of the Eastern Capital; Zhao Kui Jing-He Pacification Commissioner, prefect of Yingtian and Custodian of the Southern Capital; and Quan Zicai Guan-Shaan Pacification Commissioner, prefect of Henan and Custodian of the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 甲午，權邵武軍王野以平建陽寇有功，官兩轉，餘推賞有差。

translations.literal: On jiawu, acting Shaowu Army Wang Ye, for merit in pacifying the Jianyang bandits, was advanced two ranks in office, with graded rewards for the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu acting Shaowu Army Wang Ye, for merit in pacifying the Jianyang bandits, was advanced two ranks in office, with graded rewards for the others.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，趙範依舊京西、湖北安撫制置大使、知襄陽府。

translations.literal: On gengzi of the ninth month, Zhao Fan retained his former posts as Jingxi and Hubei Pacification Grand Commissioner and prefect of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the ninth month Zhao Fan retained his former posts as Jingxi and Hubei Pacification Grand Commissioner and prefect of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，熒惑入井。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Mars entered Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Mars entered the mansion Jing.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，趙範言：「趙葵、全子才輕遣偏師復西京，趙楷、劉子澄參贊失計，師退無律，致後陣敗覆。

translations.literal: On renyin, Zhao Fan said: "Zhao Kui and Quan Zicai rashly sent detached columns to recover the Western Capital; Zhao Kai and Liu Zicheng as staff officers miscalculated; the army withdrew without discipline, causing the rear array to be defeated and overrun.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhao Fan said: "Zhao Kui and Quan Zicai rashly sent detached columns to recover the Western Capital; Zhao Kai and Liu Zicheng as staff officers miscalculated; the army withdrew without discipline, causing the rear array to be defeated and overrun.

sentences.zh: 」詔趙葵削一秩，措置河南、京東營田邊備；

translations.literal: An edict reduced Zhao Kui one rank and charged him with arranging military colonies and frontier defense in Henan and Huaidong;
translations.idiomatic: An edict reduced Zhao Kui one rank and charged him with arranging military colonies and frontier defense in Henan and Huaidong;

sentences.zh: 全子才削一秩，措置唐、鄧、息營田邊備；

translations.literal: Quan Zicai reduced one rank and charged with arranging military colonies and frontier defense in Tang, Deng, and Xi.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Zicai was reduced one rank and charged with arranging military colonies and frontier defense in Tang, Deng, and Xi.

sentences.zh: 劉子澄、趙楷並削三秩放罷。

translations.literal: Liu Zicheng and Zhao Kai were both reduced three ranks and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zicheng and Zhao Kai were both reduced three ranks and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 又言：「楊義一軍之敗，皆由徐敏子、范用吉怠於赴援，致不能支。

translations.literal: He further said: "The defeat of Yang Yi's army was entirely because Xu Minzi and Fan Yongji were slack in rushing to aid, causing inability to hold.
translations.idiomatic: He further said: "The defeat of Yang Yi's army was entirely because Xu Minzi and Fan Yongji were slack in rushing to aid, causing inability to hold.

sentences.zh: 」詔范用吉降武翼郎，徐敏子削三秩放罷，楊義削四秩，勒停自效。

translations.literal: An edict demoted Fan Yongji to Martial Wings Gentleman; Xu Minzi reduced three ranks and dismissed; Yang Yi reduced four ranks and forbidden service until he renders merit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict demoted Fan Yongji to Martial Wings Gentleman; Xu Minzi was reduced three ranks and dismissed; Yang Yi was reduced four ranks and forbidden service until he renders merit.

sentences.zh: 己酉，真德秀言：權臣罔上，講筵官亦傅會其言，今承其弊，有當慮者五事，並及泉、漳寇盜、鹽法之弊。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Zhen Dexiu said: powerful ministers deceived the ruler; classics-colloquium officials also echoed their words—now inheriting their abuses, there are five matters that should be worried over, including bandits in Quan and Zhang and abuses of the salt law.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Zhen Dexiu said that powerful ministers deceived the ruler and classics-colloquium officials also echoed their words—now inheriting their abuses, there were five matters that should be worried over, including bandits in Quan and Zhang and abuses of the salt law.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and adopted his counsel.

sentences.zh: 詔：進士何霆編類朱熹解注文字，有補經筵，授上文學。

translations.literal: An edict: jinshi He Ting compiled Zhu Xi's commentarial texts, benefiting the classics colloquium—appointed Gentleman for Promoting Literature.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that jinshi He Ting compiled Zhu Xi's commentarial texts, benefiting the classics colloquium, and appointed him Gentleman for Promoting Literature.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，京、湖制司創鎮北軍，詔以襄陽府駐紮御前忠衛軍爲名。

translations.literal: On renzi of the eleventh month, the Jing-Hu Pacification Office created the Suppressing-North Army; an edict named it the Imperial Loyal Guard Army garrisoned at Xiangyang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the eleventh month the Jing-Hu Pacification Office created the Suppressing-North Army; an edict named it the Imperial Loyal Guard Army garrisoned at Xiangyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太白經天。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Great White Star crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Great White Star crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，大元遣王楫來。

translations.literal: On jimao of the twelfth month, Great Yuan dispatched Wang Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the twelfth month Great Yuan dispatched Wang Ji.

sentences.zh: 戊子，王楫辭於後殿。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Wang Ji took leave at the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Wang Ji took leave at the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣鄒伸之、李復禮、喬仕安、劉溥報謝，各進二秩。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Zou Shenzhi, Li Fuli, Qiao Shi'an, and Liu Pu were dispatched to return thanks, each advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zou Shenzhi, Li Fuli, Qiao Shi'an, and Liu Pu were dispatched to return thanks, each advanced two ranks.
